source.text: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא נִקְרָ֛א בְּסֵ֥פֶר מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּאָזְנֵ֣י הָעָ֑ם וְנִמְצָא֙ כָּת֣וּב בּ֔וֹ אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹא־יָב֨וֹא עַמֹּנִ֧י וּמֹאָבִ֛י בִּקְהַ֥ל הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: On that day it was read in [the] book of Moses in [the] ears of the people, and was found written in it that not shall come an Ammonite and a Moabite into [the] assembly of God until forever,

en.L: On that day it was read in the book of Moses in the ears of the people, and it was found written in it that an Ammonite or a Moabite shall not come into the assembly of God, even forever,
en.B: On that day the book of Moses was read aloud for the people to hear, and in it was found written that no Ammonite or Moabite should ever enter the assembly of God,
en.R: On that day the book of Moses was read aloud to the people. They found a law written in it that no one from Ammon or Moab could ever be a member of God's assembly,

es.L: Aquel día se leyó en el libro de Moisés a oídos del pueblo, y se encontró escrito en él que no entrará el amonita ni el moabita en la asamblea de Dios, hasta para siempre,
es.B: Aquel día se leyó en voz alta el libro de Moisés para que el pueblo lo oyera, y se encontró escrito en él que ningún amonita ni moabita debía entrar jamás en la asamblea de Dios,
es.R: Aquel día se leyó en voz alta el libro de Moisés al pueblo. Encontraron escrita en él una ley que decía que nadie de Amón ni de Moab podría nunca ser miembro de la asamblea de Dios,

fr.L: Ce jour-là, on lut dans le livre de Moïse aux oreilles du peuple, et l’on y trouva écrit que l’Ammonite et le Moabite n’entreront pas dans l’assemblée de Dieu, à jamais,
fr.B: Ce jour-là, on lut à haute voix le livre de Moïse devant le peuple, et l’on y trouva écrit qu’aucun Ammonite ni aucun Moabite ne devait jamais entrer dans l’assemblée de Dieu,
fr.R: Ce jour-là, on a lu à haute voix le livre de Moïse au peuple. On y a trouvé une loi qui disait que personne d’Ammon ou de Moab ne pourrait jamais faire partie de l’assemblée de Dieu,

sw.L: Siku ile kilisomwa kitabu cha Musa masikioni mwa watu, na ikaonekana imeandikwa ndani yake kwamba Mwamoni na Mmoabu wasiingie katika kusanyiko la Mungu, hata milele,
sw.B: Siku ile kitabu cha Musa kilisomwa kwa sauti watu wakisikia, na ndani yake ikaonekana imeandikwa kwamba Mwamoni au Mmoabu yeyote asiingie kamwe katika kusanyiko la Mungu,
sw.R: Siku ile kitabu cha Musa kilisomwa kwa sauti mbele ya watu. Wakakuta sheria iliyoandikwa ndani yake kwamba hakuna mtu wa Amoni wala wa Moabu atakayeweza kamwe kuwa mshiriki wa kusanyiko la Mungu,

vi.L: Trong ngày ấy, người ta đọc trong sách Môi-se vào tai dân chúng, và thấy có chép trong đó rằng người Am-môn và người Mô-áp sẽ không được vào hội của Đức Chúa Trời, cho đến đời đời,
vi.B: Ngày hôm ấy, người ta đọc lớn tiếng sách Môi-se cho dân chúng nghe, và thấy có chép trong đó rằng không bao giờ người Am-môn hay người Mô-áp được vào hội của Đức Chúa Trời,
vi.R: Ngày hôm ấy, người ta đọc lớn sách Môi-se cho dân chúng nghe. Họ thấy trong đó có chép một luật nói rằng không ai thuộc dân Am-môn hay Mô-áp được làm thành viên của hội chúng Đức Chúa Trời,

ko.L: 그날에 모세의 책을 백성의 귀에 낭독했는데, 그 안에 암몬 사람과 모압 사람은 하나님의 총회에 영원히 들어오지 못한다고 기록된 것이 발견되었다.
ko.B: 그날 백성이 듣도록 모세의 책을 소리 내어 읽었는데, 거기에 암몬 사람이나 모압 사람은 결코 하나님의 총회에 들어올 수 없다고 기록되어 있었다.
ko.R: 그날 백성에게 모세의 책을 소리 내어 읽어 주었다. 거기에는 암몬이나 모압 출신은 누구도 하나님의 총회에 속할 수 없다는 율법이 적혀 있었다.

pt.L: Naquele dia se leu no livro de Moisés aos ouvidos do povo, e foi achado escrito nele que não entrará o amonita nem o moabita na assembleia de Deus, para sempre,
pt.B: Naquele dia o livro de Moisés foi lido em voz alta para o povo ouvir, e nele se achou escrito que nenhum amonita ou moabita jamais poderia entrar na assembleia de Deus,
pt.R: Naquele dia o livro de Moisés foi lido em voz alta para o povo. Encontraram nele uma lei que dizia que ninguém de Amom ou de Moabe jamais poderia fazer parte da assembleia de Deus,

am.L: በዚያ ቀን በሕዝቡ ጆሮ በሙሴ መጽሐፍ ተነበበ፤ አሞናዊና ሞዓባዊ ለዘላለም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጉባኤ እንዳይገቡ በእርሱ ተጽፎ ተገኘ፤
am.B: በዚያ ቀን ሕዝቡ እየሰሙ የሙሴ መጽሐፍ ተነበበ፤ በውስጡም አሞናዊ ወይም ሞዓባዊ ፈጽሞ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጉባኤ እንዳይገባ ተጽፎ ተገኘ፤
am.R: በዚያ ቀን የሙሴ መጽሐፍ ለሕዝቡ ጮክ ተብሎ ተነበበ። በውስጡም ከአሞን ወይም ከሞዓብ የሆነ ማንም ሰው ፈጽሞ የእግዚአብሔር ጉባኤ አባል መሆን እንደማይችል የሚል ሕግ አገኙ፤

hi.L: उस दिन लोगों के कानों में मूसा की पुस्तक में से पढ़ा गया, और उसमें यह लिखा पाया गया कि कोई अम्मोनी या मोआबी परमेश्वर की सभा में कभी न आए, सदा तक भी,
hi.B: उस दिन मूसा की पुस्तक लोगों को ऊँचे स्वर से पढ़कर सुनाई गई, और उसमें यह लिखा पाया गया कि कोई अम्मोनी या मोआबी परमेश्वर की सभा में कभी न आए,
hi.R: उस दिन मूसा की पुस्तक लोगों को पढ़कर सुनाई गई। उसमें उन्हें एक नियम लिखा मिला कि अम्मोन या मोआब का कोई भी व्यक्ति कभी परमेश्वर की सभा का सदस्य न बने,

ru.L: В тот день читали в книге Моисея в уши народа, и нашли написанным в ней, что аммонитянин и моавитянин не войдёт в собрание Божье вовек,
ru.B: В тот день книгу Моисея читали вслух перед народом, и в ней нашли написанным, что ни аммонитянин, ни моавитянин никогда не может войти в собрание Божье,
ru.R: В тот день книгу Моисея читали вслух народу. В ней нашли закон, что никто из Аммона или Моава никогда не может войти в собрание Божьего народа,

ja.L: その日、モーセの書が民の耳に読まれた。そして、その中に、アンモン人とモアブ人は永遠に神の集会に入ってはならない、と書かれているのが見いだされた。
ja.B: その日、民に聞こえるようにモーセの書が朗読された。すると、その中に、アンモン人とモアブ人は決して神の集会に加わってはならない、と書かれていた。
ja.R: その日、モーセの書が民の前で読み上げられました。その中に、アンモンやモアブの人は、だれも決して神の民の集まりに加わってはならない、というきまりが書いてありました。

decisions.choice: the law quoted: Deuteronomy 23:4-6
decisions.reason: The verse and the next sum up Deuteronomy 23:4-6 (Hebrew numbering; 23:3-5 in most Bibles): no Ammonite or Moabite may enter the assembly of the LORD, "even to the tenth generation, forever", because they did not meet Israel with food and water and hired Balaam to curse them.

decisions.choice: the assembly of God: Israel gathered as God's people
decisions.reason: The assembly is the whole people gathered for worship and decision (Deuteronomy 23:2-9). To "enter" it means to be counted a full member of the worshiping community. The law in Deuteronomy does not bar every foreigner: Edomites and Egyptians could enter in the third generation (Deuteronomy 23:8-9).

decisions.choice: on that day: at a public reading of the law
decisions.reason: "On that day" links this reading loosely to the time of the dedication (12:43-44); it need not be the same day. Verses 4-6 show that the events of this chapter came after Nehemiah's return from the king, years after the wall was finished.

decisions.choice: read aloud for the people to hear (Balanced); read aloud to the people (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew idiom "in the ears of the people"; Balanced and Readable say what it means.

decisions.choice: passé simple at Literal and Balanced ("on lut"); passé composé at Readable ("on a lu")
decisions.reason: For Nehemiah's narrative in this chapter, as in the rest of the book: the passé simple is the tense of written narrative, the passé composé the tense most readers use today.

decisions.choice: the sentence closes at the end of verse 1; verse 2 gives the reason as its own sentence ("…때문이다")
decisions.reason: Korean puts the reason before the main verb; to keep each verse's content after its own number, verse 1 ends with what was found written and verse 2 explains why.

decisions.choice: não entrará o amonita nem o moabita na assembleia (L); nenhum amonita ou moabita ... entrar na assembleia (B); fazer parte da assembleia (R)
decisions.reason: The law quoted is Deuteronomy 23:4-6 (m1), so each level keeps its Portuguese: the future "não entrará" at Literal, "assembleia" for the people gathered as God's own (m2), and Readable's "fazer parte", which says what entering means.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in this chapter's Amharic (the English has them in verses 22 and 29)
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting has nothing to change in Amharic.

decisions.choice: Verses 1-2 keep the Amharic of Deuteronomy 23:4-6 on main where the Hebrew is the same ("አሞናዊና ሞዓባዊ ... አይግቡ", "የ... ጉባኤ አባል መሆን" at Readable, "እንጀራና ውኃ ይዘው", "እርግማኑን ወደ በረከት ለወጠው"), with "እግዚአብሔር" where Nehemiah says "God" for Deuteronomy's "the LORD"
decisions.reason: Nehemiah reads out and sums up the law of Deuteronomy 23:4-6; the Amharic lets the reader hear the same law.

decisions.choice: "कोई अम्मोनी या मोआबी ... सभा में ... न आए"
decisions.reason: The law quoted is Deuteronomy 23:4-6 (meaning m1), so Literal and Balanced take its wording in this translation; the assembly here is "of God" where Deuteronomy has "of the LORD", and the Hindi follows Nehemiah.

decisions.choice: the wording of Deuteronomy 23:4-6
decisions.reason: The verse and the next quote Deuteronomy 23:4-6; Russian keeps its words in this translation ("аммонитянин и моавитянин", "собрание", "вовек", "обратил проклятие в благословение") so the reader sees the quotation.

decisions.choice: qehal ha'elohim "神の集会" (L, B), "神の民の集まり" (R)
decisions.reason: As Deuteronomy 23:4 (主の集会; R 主の民の集まり), which this verse quotes.

source.text: כִּ֣י לֹ֧א קִדְּמ֛וּ אֶת־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בַּלֶּ֣חֶם וּבַמָּ֑יִם וַיִּשְׂכֹּ֨ר עָלָ֤יו אֶת־בִּלְעָם֙ לְקַֽלְל֔וֹ וַיַּהֲפֹ֧ךְ אֱלֹהֵ֛ינוּ הַקְּלָלָ֖ה לִבְרָכָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: because not they met the sons of Israel with bread and with water, and he hired against him Balaam to curse him; and turned our God the curse into a blessing.

en.L: because they did not meet the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel with bread and with water, and [Moab] hired Balaam against him to curse him; and our God turned the curse into a blessing.
en.B: because they had not met the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} with food and water, but had hired Balaam against them to curse them; yet our God turned the curse into a blessing.
en.R: This was because the Ammonites and Moabites had not met the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} with food and water when they came out of Egypt. Instead, Moab paid Balaam to curse them. But our God turned that curse into a blessing.

es.L: porque no salieron al encuentro de los hijos de Israel con pan y con agua, y [Moab] contrató contra él a Balaam para que lo maldijera; y nuestro Dios convirtió la maldición en bendición.
es.B: porque no habían salido al encuentro de los israelitas con comida y agua, sino que habían contratado a Balaam contra ellos para que los maldijera; pero nuestro Dios convirtió la maldición en bendición.
es.R: Esto era porque los amonitas y los moabitas no habían salido a recibir a los israelitas con comida y agua cuando salieron de Egipto. En cambio, Moab le pagó a Balaam para que los maldijera. Pero nuestro Dios convirtió aquella maldición en bendición.

fr.L: parce qu’ils n’étaient pas venus à la rencontre des {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël avec du pain et de l’eau, et [Moab] avait payé contre lui Balaam pour le maudire ; et notre Dieu changea la malédiction en bénédiction.
fr.B: parce qu’ils n’étaient pas venus à la rencontre des {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} avec de la nourriture et de l’eau, mais avaient payé Balaam contre eux pour les maudire ; et notre Dieu changea la malédiction en bénédiction.
fr.R: C’était parce que les Ammonites et les Moabites n’étaient pas venus à la rencontre des {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} avec de la nourriture et de l’eau quand ils sortaient d’Égypte. Au contraire, Moab avait payé Balaam pour qu’il les maudisse. Mais notre Dieu a changé cette malédiction en bénédiction.

sw.L: kwa sababu hawakuwalaki wana wa Israeli kwa mkate na kwa maji, na [Moabu] akamwajiri Balaamu juu yake ili amlaani; lakini Mungu wetu akaigeuza laana kuwa baraka.
sw.B: kwa sababu hawakuwalaki Waisraeli kwa chakula na maji, bali walimwajiri Balaamu juu yao ili awalaani; lakini Mungu wetu aliigeuza laana hiyo kuwa baraka.
sw.R: Hii ni kwa sababu Waamoni na Wamoabu hawakuwapokea Waisraeli kwa chakula na maji walipotoka Misri. Badala yake, Moabu alimlipa Balaamu ili awalaani. Lakini Mungu wetu aliigeuza laana hiyo kuwa baraka.

vi.L: vì họ đã không đem bánh và nước ra đón con cái Y-sơ-ra-ên, và [Mô-áp] đã thuê Ba-la-am chống lại dân ấy để nguyền rủa dân ấy; nhưng Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta đã đổi lời nguyền rủa thành phước lành.
vi.B: vì họ đã không đem thức ăn và nước ra đón dân Y-sơ-ra-ên, mà lại thuê Ba-la-am chống lại họ để nguyền rủa họ; nhưng Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta đã đổi lời nguyền rủa thành phước lành.
vi.R: Đó là vì người Am-môn và người Mô-áp đã không đem thức ăn và nước ra đón dân Y-sơ-ra-ên khi họ ra khỏi Ai Cập. Trái lại, Mô-áp đã trả tiền cho Ba-la-am để nguyền rủa họ. Nhưng Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta đã biến lời nguyền rủa ấy thành phước lành.

ko.L: 그들이 빵과 물을 가지고 이스라엘 자손을 맞이하지 않았고, [모압이] 그를 저주하게 하려고 그를 대적하여 발람을 고용했기 때문이다. 그러나 우리 하나님께서 그 저주를 복으로 바꾸셨다.
ko.B: 그들이 먹을 것과 물을 가지고 이스라엘 자손을 맞이하지 않고, 오히려 발람을 고용하여 그들을 저주하게 했기 때문이다. 그러나 우리 하나님께서는 그 저주를 복으로 바꾸셨다.
ko.R: 그것은 이스라엘 자손이 이집트에서 나올 때 암몬 사람들과 모압 사람들이 먹을 것과 물을 가지고 그들을 맞으러 나오지 않았기 때문이다. 오히려 모압은 발람에게 돈을 주어 그들을 저주하게 했다. 그러나 우리 하나님께서 그 저주를 복으로 바꾸셨다.

pt.L: porque não vieram ao encontro dos filhos de Israel com pão e com água, e [Moabe] contratou contra ele Balaão para amaldiçoá-lo; e o nosso Deus mudou a maldição em bênção.
pt.B: porque não tinham ido ao encontro dos israelitas com comida e água e ainda tinham contratado Balaão contra eles para amaldiçoá-los; mas o nosso Deus transformou a maldição em bênção.
pt.R: Isso porque os amonitas e os moabitas não tinham ido ao encontro dos israelitas com comida e água quando eles saíram do Egito. Em vez disso, Moabe pagou a Balaão para amaldiçoá-los. Mas o nosso Deus transformou aquela maldição em bênção.

am.L: [ይህም] የእስራኤልን ልጆች እንጀራና ውኃ ይዘው ስላልተቀበሏቸው፣ ይረግመውም ዘንድ [ሞዓብ] በለዓምን በእርሱ ላይ ስለ ቀጠረ ነው፤ አምላካችን ግን እርግማኑን ወደ በረከት ለወጠው።
am.B: ይህም የእስራኤልን ልጆች ምግብና ውኃ ይዘው ሊቀበሏቸው ስላልወጡ፣ ይልቁንም ሊረግማቸው በለዓምን ስለ ቀጠሩባቸው ነው፤ አምላካችን ግን እርግማኑን ወደ በረከት ለወጠው።
am.R: ይህም የሆነው አሞናውያንና ሞዓባውያን እስራኤላውያን ከግብፅ በወጡ ጊዜ ምግብና ውኃ ይዘው ሊቀበሏቸው ስላልወጡ ነው። ይልቁንም ሞዓብ እንዲረግማቸው በለዓምን በገንዘብ ቀጠረ። አምላካችን ግን ያን እርግማን ወደ በረከት ለወጠው።

hi.L: क्योंकि वे रोटी और पानी लेकर {{gender:इस्राएल की सन्तान|इस्राएल के पुत्रों}} से मिलने न आए, और [मोआब ने] उसके विरुद्ध बिलाम को मज़दूरी पर बुलाया कि उसे शाप दे; और हमारे परमेश्वर ने उस शाप को आशीष में बदल दिया।
hi.B: क्योंकि वे भोजन और पानी लेकर इस्राएलियों से मिलने न आए, पर उन्होंने उनके विरुद्ध बिलाम को मज़दूरी पर बुलाया कि वह उन्हें शाप दे; फिर भी हमारे परमेश्वर ने उस शाप को आशीष में बदल दिया।
hi.R: इसका कारण यह था कि जब इस्राएली मिस्र से निकलकर आए, तब अम्मोनी और मोआबी भोजन और पानी लेकर उनसे मिलने न आए। इसके बजाय मोआब ने बिलाम को पैसे देकर बुलाया कि वह उन्हें शाप दे। पर हमारे परमेश्वर ने उस शाप को आशीष में बदल दिया।

ru.L: потому что они не встретили {{gender:детей Израиля|сынов Израиля}} с хлебом и с водой, и он нанял против него Валаама, чтобы проклясть его; но обратил наш Бог проклятие в благословение.
ru.B: потому что они не встретили израильтян с хлебом и водой, а наняли против них Валаама, чтобы он проклял их; но наш Бог обратил проклятие в благословение.
ru.R: Это потому, что аммонитяне и моавитяне не встретили израильтян с хлебом и водой, когда те вышли из Египта. Вместо этого Моав заплатил Валааму, чтобы тот проклял их. Но наш Бог превратил это проклятие в благословение.

ja.L: 彼らがパンと水をもってイスラエルの子らを迎えず、彼を呪わせるために、彼に対してバラムを雇ったからである。しかし、わたしたちの神は、その呪いを祝福に変えられた。
ja.B: 彼らは食べ物と水をもってイスラエルの人々を迎えず、かえってバラムを雇って彼らを呪わせようとしたからである。しかし、わたしたちの神は、その呪いを祝福に変えられた。
ja.R: それは、イスラエルの人々がエジプトから出て来たとき、アンモン人とモアブ人が食べ物と水を持って迎えに来なかったからです。それどころか、モアブはバラムにお金を払って、イスラエルの人々をのろわせようとしました。しかし、わたしたちの神は、そののろいを祝福に変えてくださいました。

decisions.choice: Balaam, and the curse turned to blessing
decisions.reason: Balak king of Moab hired the prophet Balaam to curse Israel, but God made him bless them instead (Numbers 22-24; Deuteronomy 23:5-6). "He hired" is singular in Hebrew: Moab, or its king, did the hiring.

decisions.choice: against him ... curse him: Israel as one people
decisions.reason: The Hebrew speaks of Israel as "him", one people, as Deuteronomy 23:5 does; the sense is the people as a whole.

decisions.choice: bread: food
decisions.reason: "Bread" stands for food in general, provisions for a people on the march (Deuteronomy 23:5; 2:28-29).

decisions.choice: when they came out of Egypt
decisions.reason: Readable adds when this happened, from Deuteronomy 23:5.

decisions.choice: them
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew "him"; Balanced and Readable use the plural that English uses for a people.

decisions.choice: os filhos de Israel (L); os israelitas (B, R); no gender setting; Balaão; mudou (L), transformou (B, R) a maldição em bênção
decisions.reason: As 10:40 and Nehemiah 1:6 in Portuguese: "filhos" and "israelitas" already include women. The rest keeps the Portuguese of Deuteronomy 23:5-6 (m1), "contratou Balaão", "mudou ... a maldição em bênção" at Literal and "transformou" at Balanced; Literal keeps the singular "ele" for Israel as one people (m2).

decisions.choice: No gender span on "የእስራኤል ልጆች" (Literal, Balanced), "እስራኤላውያን" (Readable), or on "የይሁዳ ልጆች" / "የይሁዳ ሰዎች" (verse 16)
alternatives: Gender setting spans as in English
decisions.reason: "ልጆች", "ሰዎች" and "እስራኤላውያን" already include men and women in Amharic, so there are not two wordings for the setting to choose between; this holds for the chapter.

decisions.choice: {{gender:इस्राएल की सन्तान|इस्राएल के पुत्रों}} (L); "इस्राएलियों" (B, R), no span
decisions.reason: The sons of Israel in the forms of the Pentateuch note: the span at Literal; "इस्राएली", already inclusive, at Balanced and Readable, where the English has a span. Literal keeps the singular "उसके", "उसे" for Israel as one people (meaning m2).

decisions.choice: "израильтяне" with no gender span
decisions.reason: As in 8:14: Russian "израильтяне" already includes men and women, so only Literal keeps the span.

decisions.choice: bene yisra'el "イスラエルの子ら" (L), "イスラエルの人々" (B, R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: Japanese 子ら and 人々 are not gendered, so the English gender setting has nothing to change here.

decisions.choice: Balaam "バラム"; qalal "呪う" (L, B), "のろう" (R)
decisions.reason: As Numbers 22-24 and Deuteronomy 23:5-6.

source.text: וַיְהִ֖י כְּשָׁמְעָ֣ם אֶת־הַתּוֹרָ֑ה וַיַּבְדִּ֥ילוּ כָל־עֵ֖רֶב מִיִּשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was when they heard the law, and they separated all [the] mixed from Israel.

en.L: And it happened, when they heard the law, that they separated all [the] mixed [people] from Israel.
en.B: When the people heard the law, they separated from Israel all who were of mixed descent.
en.R: When the people heard this law, they removed from Israel everyone who had foreign ancestors.

es.L: Y sucedió que, cuando oyeron la ley, separaron de Israel a toda [la gente] mezclada.
es.B: Cuando el pueblo oyó la ley, separaron de Israel a todos los que eran de ascendencia mezclada.
es.R: Cuando el pueblo oyó esta ley, apartaron de Israel a todos los que tenían antepasados extranjeros.

fr.L: Et il arriva, quand ils entendirent la loi, qu’ils séparèrent d’Israël tout [le peuple] mêlé.
fr.B: Quand le peuple eut entendu la loi, on sépara d’Israël tous ceux qui étaient d’ascendance mêlée.
fr.R: Quand le peuple a entendu cette loi, on a écarté d’Israël tous ceux qui avaient des ancêtres étrangers.

sw.L: Ikawa, waliposikia sheria, wakawatenga na Israeli [watu] wote waliochanganyika.
sw.B: Watu waliposikia sheria hiyo, waliwatenga na Israeli wote waliokuwa na asili iliyochanganyika.
sw.R: Watu walipoisikia sheria hii, waliwaondoa katika Israeli wote waliokuwa na mababu wa kigeni.

vi.L: Và xảy ra, khi họ nghe luật pháp, họ tách khỏi Y-sơ-ra-ên tất cả [những người] pha trộn.
vi.B: Khi dân chúng nghe luật pháp ấy, họ tách khỏi Y-sơ-ra-ên mọi người có dòng dõi pha trộn.
vi.R: Khi nghe luật này, dân chúng loại ra khỏi Y-sơ-ra-ên mọi người có tổ tiên là người nước ngoài.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 율법을 들었을 때, 섞인 [사람들을] 모두 이스라엘에서 구별해 냈다.
ko.B: 백성은 율법을 듣고, 혈통이 섞인 사람들을 모두 이스라엘에서 갈라냈다.
ko.R: 백성은 이 율법을 듣고, 조상 가운데 외국 사람이 있는 사람들을 모두 이스라엘에서 떼어 냈다.

pt.L: E aconteceu que, quando ouviram a Lei, separaram de Israel toda a mistura [de gente].
pt.B: Quando o povo ouviu a Lei, separou de Israel todos os que eram de origem estrangeira.
pt.R: Quando o povo ouviu essa lei, tirou do meio de Israel todos os que tinham antepassados estrangeiros.

am.L: ሕጉንም በሰሙ ጊዜ እንዲህ ሆነ፤ ድብልቁን [ሕዝብ] ሁሉ ከእስራኤል ለዩ።
am.B: ሕዝቡ ሕጉን በሰሙ ጊዜ ከባዕድ ዘር የተደባለቁትን ሁሉ ከእስራኤል ለዩ።
am.R: ሕዝቡ ይህን ሕግ በሰሙ ጊዜ የባዕድ አገር ቅድመ አያቶች ያሏቸውን ሁሉ ከእስራኤል አስወጡ።

hi.L: और ऐसा हुआ कि जब उन्होंने व्यवस्था सुनी, तब उन्होंने सब मिले-जुले [लोगों] को इस्राएल से अलग कर दिया।
hi.B: जब लोगों ने व्यवस्था सुनी, तब उन्होंने उन सब को इस्राएल से अलग कर दिया जो मिले-जुले वंश के थे।
hi.R: जब लोगों ने यह नियम सुना, तब उन्होंने उन सब को इस्राएल से अलग कर दिया जिनके पूर्वज विदेशी थे।

ru.L: И было, когда услышали Закон, отделили всех смешанных от Израиля.
ru.B: Когда народ услышал Закон, от Израиля отделили всех, кто был смешанного происхождения.
ru.R: Когда люди услышали этот закон, они удалили из Израиля всех, у кого были предки из чужих народов.

ja.L: そして、彼らが律法を聞いたとき、混じり合った者たちをことごとくイスラエルから分けた。
ja.B: 民はこの律法を聞くと、外国の血筋の者たちをみな、イスラエルから分け離した。
ja.R: 民はこのきまりを聞くと、外国人の先祖を持つ人たちをみな、イスラエルから離しました。

decisions.choice: the mixed: people of foreign descent
decisions.reason: The word is used of the "mixed crowd" of other peoples who left Egypt with Israel (Exodus 12:38). Here it means those of foreign, especially Ammonite and Moabite, descent living among Israel.

decisions.choice: separated from Israel: excluded from the assembly
decisions.reason: The text does not say whether they were sent away or only kept from the assembly and its worship; the law read in verse 1 concerns entering the assembly. The same separation is described in 9:2 and 10:29.

decisions.choice: the law: the law of Moses
decisions.reason: The law here is what was read from the book of Moses in verse 1.

decisions.choice: toda a mistura [de gente] (L); todos os que eram de origem estrangeira (B); os que tinham antepassados estrangeiros (R)
decisions.reason: The word is the one of Exodus 12:38, "uma grande mistura de gente" in Portuguese, for the other peoples who left Egypt with Israel (m1); Literal keeps it, and Balanced and Readable say whom it means. "Misturado" would sound like a judgment on mixed blood.

decisions.choice: "ድብልቁ [ሕዝብ]" (Literal), as "ድብልቅ ሕዝብ" for the mixed multitude of Exodus 12:38 on main; "ከባዕድ ዘር የተደባለቁ" (Balanced)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is the one Exodus uses for the mixed company that left Egypt with Israel.

decisions.choice: 'erev "混じり合った者たち" (L), "外国の血筋の者たち" (B), "外国人の先祖を持つ人たち" (R)
decisions.reason: The word is used in Exodus 12:38 for the mixed crowd; here it names people of foreign descent.

source.text: וְלִפְנֵ֣י מִזֶּ֔ה אֶלְיָשִׁיב֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן נָת֖וּן בְּלִשְׁכַּ֣ת בֵּית־אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ קָר֖וֹב לְטוֹבִיָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And before this, Eliashib the priest, appointed over [the] chamber of [the] house of our God, [was] related to Tobiah,

en.L: And before this, Eliashib the priest, appointed over the chamber of the house of our God, [was] related to Tobiah,
en.B: Before this, Eliashib the priest, who had been put in charge of the storerooms of the house of our God and was related to Tobiah,
en.R: Earlier, Eliashib the priest had been put in charge of the storerooms in the temple of our God. Eliashib was related to Tobiah.

es.L: Y antes de esto, Eliasib el sacerdote, puesto sobre la cámara de la casa de nuestro Dios, [era] pariente de Tobías,
es.B: Antes de esto, el sacerdote Eliasib, que había sido puesto a cargo de los almacenes de la casa de nuestro Dios y era pariente de Tobías,
es.R: Antes, el sacerdote Eliasib había sido puesto a cargo de los almacenes del templo de nuestro Dios. Eliasib era pariente de Tobías.

fr.L: Et avant cela, Éliashib le prêtre, établi sur la chambre de la maison de notre Dieu, [était] parent de Tobiya,
fr.B: Avant cela, le prêtre Éliashib, qui avait été chargé des réserves de la maison de notre Dieu et qui était parent de Tobiya,
fr.R: Auparavant, le prêtre Éliashib avait été chargé des réserves du temple de notre Dieu. Éliashib était parent de Tobiya.

sw.L: Na kabla ya haya, Eliashibu kuhani, aliyewekwa juu ya chumba cha nyumba ya Mungu wetu, [alikuwa] jamaa wa Tobia,
sw.B: Kabla ya hayo, Eliashibu kuhani, aliyekuwa amewekwa kusimamia vyumba vya akiba vya nyumba ya Mungu wetu, naye alikuwa jamaa wa Tobia,
sw.R: Kabla ya hapo, Eliashibu kuhani alikuwa amewekwa kusimamia vyumba vya akiba katika hekalu la Mungu wetu. Eliashibu alikuwa jamaa wa Tobia.

vi.L: Và trước việc này, thầy tế lễ Ê-li-a-síp, được lập coi phòng của nhà Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta, [là] bà con với Tô-bi-gia,
vi.B: Trước đó, thầy tế lễ Ê-li-a-síp, người được giao coi các phòng kho của nhà Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta và là bà con với Tô-bi-gia,
vi.R: Trước đó, thầy tế lễ Ê-li-a-síp đã được giao coi các phòng kho trong đền thờ của Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta. Ê-li-a-síp là bà con với Tô-bi-gia.

ko.L: 그리고 이 [일] 전에, 우리 하나님의 집의 방을 맡은 제사장 엘리아십은 도비야와 가까운 사이[였는데],
ko.B: 이보다 앞서, 우리 하나님의 집의 곳간들을 맡은 제사장 엘리아십은 도비야와 친척이 되는 사람이었는데,
ko.R: 그전에 제사장 엘리아십이 우리 하나님의 성전 창고들을 맡고 있었다. 엘리아십은 도비야와 친척 사이였다.

pt.L: E antes disto, Eliasibe, o sacerdote, encarregado da câmara da casa do nosso Deus, [era] parente de Tobias,
pt.B: Antes disso, Eliasibe, o sacerdote, que tinha sido encarregado dos depósitos da casa do nosso Deus e era parente de Tobias,
pt.R: Antes disso, o sacerdote Eliasibe tinha sido encarregado dos depósitos do templo do nosso Deus. Eliasibe era parente de Tobias.

am.L: ከዚህም በፊት በአምላካችን ቤት ክፍል ላይ የተሾመው ካህኑ ኤልያሴብ የጦቢያ ዘመድ [ነበረ]፤
am.B: ከዚህ በፊት በአምላካችን ቤት ዕቃ ቤቶች ላይ ኃላፊ ሆኖ የተሾመውና የጦቢያ ዘመድ የነበረው ካህኑ ኤልያሴብ፣
am.R: ቀደም ሲል ካህኑ ኤልያሴብ በአምላካችን ቤተ መቅደስ ዕቃ ቤቶች ላይ ኃላፊ ሆኖ ተሹሞ ነበር። ኤልያሴብ የጦቢያ ዘመድ ነበረ።

hi.L: और इससे पहले एल्याशीब याजक, जो हमारे परमेश्वर के भवन की कोठरी पर ठहराया गया था, तोबियाह का संबंधी [था],
hi.B: इससे पहले एल्याशीब याजक ने, जिसे हमारे परमेश्वर के भवन की भंडार की कोठरियों का अधिकारी ठहराया गया था और जो तोबियाह का संबंधी था,
hi.R: इससे पहले एल्याशीब याजक को हमारे परमेश्वर के मंदिर की भंडार की कोठरियों का अधिकारी ठहराया गया था। एल्याशीब तोबियाह का संबंधी था।

ru.L: А до этого Елиашив, священник, поставленный над комнатой дома нашего Бога, [был] родственником Товии,
ru.B: До этого священник Елиашив, которого поставили над кладовыми дома нашего Бога и который был родственником Товии,
ru.R: Ещё раньше священника Елиашива поставили отвечать за кладовые в храме нашего Бога. Елиашив был родственником Товии.

ja.L: そしてこれより前に、わたしたちの神の家の部屋の上に任じられていた祭司エルヤシブは、トビヤの縁者であって、
ja.B: これより前に、わたしたちの神の家の貯蔵室を任されていた祭司エルヤシブは、トビヤと縁続きであったが、
ja.R: これより前に、祭司エルヤシブは、わたしたちの神の神殿の倉庫の管理を任されていました。エルヤシブはトビヤの親族でした。

decisions.choice: Eliashib the priest: perhaps the high priest
decisions.reason: An Eliashib was high priest in Nehemiah's day (3:1; 12:10; 13:28). This Eliashib is called only "the priest" and has charge of the storerooms, so some think he is another man; but the high priest would have had authority over the temple rooms.

decisions.choice: Tobiah: Nehemiah's old opponent
decisions.reason: Tobiah the Ammonite official had opposed the rebuilding of the wall (2:10, 19; 4:1; 6:1-19). He had family ties with leading men of Judah (6:17-18). That an Ammonite should have a room in the temple courts runs directly against the law just read (verse 1).

decisions.choice: near to: related to
decisions.reason: The word means "near", here near by kinship or marriage (6:18 says Tobiah's son married into a Jerusalem family). It could also mean closely allied.

decisions.choice: the storerooms (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has the singular "chamber", used for the storerooms as a group; Literal keeps it.

decisions.choice: a câmara (L); os depósitos (B, R); parente de Tobias
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the singular "câmara", the word set at 12:44 for the temple's rooms; Balanced and Readable say "os depósitos" as 10:38, since the singular names the storerooms as a group (r-en-1). "Parente" says the tie of kinship or marriage (m3); Tobias as 2:10.

decisions.choice: "ጦቢያ" for Tobiah, Nehemiah's opponent, as the terms list
alternatives: "ጦብያ" (Ezra 2:60 on main, a family of returned exiles)
decisions.reason: The terms list sets "ጦቢያ" for Nehemiah's Tobiah; Ezra's family keeps its own form.

decisions.choice: "ክፍል" (Literal) for the chamber given to Tobiah; "ዕቃ ቤቶች" (Balanced, Readable) here, "ክፍል" for the room itself in verses 5-9
decisions.reason: Following the English levels: Balanced and Readable speak of storerooms where Eliashib's office is meant and of a room where Tobiah lived.

decisions.choice: "तोबियाह"
decisions.reason: Nehemiah's opponent is "तोबियाह" through the book, as "सम्बल्लत" (verse 28) and "गेशेम"; these forms are reported for the other chapters to match.

decisions.choice: "Товия"; "Санаваллат" (13:28)
decisions.reason: The traditional Russian forms of Nehemiah's opponents, Tobiah the Ammonite and Sanballat the Horonite.

source.text: וַיַּ֨עַשׂ ל֜וֹ לִשְׁכָּ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֗ה וְשָׁ֣ם הָי֪וּ לְפָנִ֟ים נֹ֠תְנִים אֶת־הַמִּנְחָ֨ה הַלְּבוֹנָ֜ה וְהַכֵּלִ֗ים וּמַעְשַׂ֤ר הַדָּגָן֙ הַתִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְהַיִּצְהָ֔ר מִצְוַת֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִ֖ים וְהַשֹּׁעֲרִ֑ים וּתְרוּמַ֖ת הַכֹּהֲנִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: and he made for him a great chamber, and there they were formerly putting the grain offering, the frankincense, and the vessels, and [the] tithe of the grain, the new wine and the fresh oil, [the] commandment of the Levites and the singers and the gatekeepers, and the contribution of the priests.

en.L: and he made for him a great chamber, and there formerly they had been putting the grain offering, the frankincense, and the vessels, and the tithe of the grain, the new wine and the fresh oil, the commandment of the Levites and the singers and the gatekeepers, and the contribution of the priests.
en.B: had made a large chamber for him, where formerly they had put the grain offering, the frankincense, and the vessels, and the tithes of grain, new wine, and olive oil commanded for the Levites, the singers, and the gatekeepers, and the contributions for the priests.
en.R: He gave Tobiah a large room that had been used to store the grain offerings, the incense, and the temple utensils. It had also held the tenth of the grain, new wine, and olive oil that God had commanded to be given to the Levites, singers, and gatekeepers, and the gifts that belonged to the priests.

es.L: y le hizo una cámara grande, donde antes ponían la ofrenda de cereal, el incienso y los utensilios, y el diezmo del grano, del vino nuevo y del aceite fresco, el mandato de los levitas y de los cantores y de los porteros, y la contribución de los sacerdotes.
es.B: le había preparado una cámara grande, donde antes se guardaban la ofrenda de cereal, el incienso y los utensilios, y los diezmos del grano, del vino nuevo y del aceite de oliva mandados para los levitas, los cantores y los porteros, y las contribuciones para los sacerdotes.
es.R: Le dio a Tobías una habitación grande que se había usado para guardar las ofrendas de cereal, el incienso y los utensilios del templo. También se guardaba allí la décima parte del grano, del vino nuevo y del aceite de oliva que Dios había mandado dar a los levitas, a los cantores y a los porteros, y los dones que pertenecían a los sacerdotes.

fr.L: et il lui fit une grande chambre, où l’on mettait auparavant l’offrande végétale, l’encens et les ustensiles, et la dîme du blé, du vin nouveau et de l’huile fraîche, le commandement des Lévites, et des chanteurs, et des portiers, et la contribution des prêtres.
fr.B: lui avait aménagé une grande chambre, où l’on déposait auparavant l’offrande végétale, l’encens et les ustensiles, ainsi que les dîmes du blé, du vin nouveau et de l’huile d’olive prescrites pour les Lévites, les chanteurs et les portiers, et les contributions pour les prêtres.
fr.R: Il avait donné à Tobiya une grande salle qui servait à garder les offrandes de céréales, l’encens et les ustensiles du temple. On y gardait aussi le dixième du blé, du vin nouveau et de l’huile d’olive que Dieu avait ordonné de donner aux Lévites, aux chanteurs et aux portiers, et les dons qui revenaient aux prêtres.

sw.L: naye akamfanyia chumba kikubwa, na humo zamani walikuwa wakiweka sadaka ya nafaka, ubani, na vyombo, na fungu la kumi la nafaka, la divai mpya na la mafuta mapya, agizo la Walawi na waimbaji na mabawabu, na mchango wa makuhani.
sw.B: alikuwa amemwandalia chumba kikubwa, ambamo zamani waliweka sadaka ya nafaka, ubani na vyombo, pamoja na fungu la kumi la nafaka, la divai mpya na la mafuta ya zeituni lililoamriwa kwa ajili ya Walawi, waimbaji na mabawabu, na michango kwa ajili ya makuhani.
sw.R: Alimpa Tobia chumba kikubwa ambacho kilitumika kuhifadhi sadaka za nafaka, ubani na vyombo vya hekalu. Pia kilihifadhi sehemu ya kumi ya nafaka, divai mpya na mafuta ya zeituni ambayo Mungu aliamuru wapewe Walawi, waimbaji na walinzi wa malango, pamoja na matoleo yaliyokuwa ya makuhani.

vi.L: và ông làm cho người ấy một phòng lớn, là nơi trước kia người ta để tế lễ ngũ cốc, nhũ hương và các vật dụng, và phần mười của ngũ cốc, rượu mới và dầu mới, là điều đã truyền cho người Lê-vi, những người ca hát và những người giữ cổng, và của lễ dâng riêng của các thầy tế lễ.
vi.B: đã dọn cho Tô-bi-gia một phòng lớn, là nơi trước kia người ta cất tế lễ ngũ cốc, nhũ hương và các vật dụng, cùng phần mười ngũ cốc, rượu mới và dầu ô-liu đã được truyền dành cho người Lê-vi, những người ca hát và những người giữ cổng, và các của lễ dâng riêng cho các thầy tế lễ.
vi.R: Ông đã cho Tô-bi-gia một phòng lớn, là nơi trước kia dùng để cất các tế lễ ngũ cốc, nhũ hương và các vật dụng trong đền thờ. Phòng ấy cũng chứa một phần mười ngũ cốc, rượu mới và dầu ô-liu mà Đức Chúa Trời đã truyền phải dâng cho người Lê-vi, những người ca hát và những người giữ cổng, cùng các lễ vật thuộc về các thầy tế lễ.

ko.L: 그를 위해 큰 방을 만들어 주었다. 그곳에는 전에 곡식 제물과 유향과 그릇들과, 레위 사람들과 노래하는 사람들과 문지기들에게 명령된 곡식과 새 포도주와 신선한 기름의 십일조와, 제사장들의 들어 바치는 예물을 두었었다.
ko.B: 그를 위해 큰 방 하나를 마련해 주었다. 그 방은 전에 곡식 제물과 유향과 그릇들, 그리고 레위 사람들과 노래하는 사람들과 문지기들에게 주도록 명령된 곡식과 새 포도주와 올리브기름의 십일조와, 제사장들에게 돌아갈 들어 바치는 예물을 두던 곳이었다.
ko.R: 그는 도비야에게 큰 방 하나를 내주었다. 그 방은 곡식 제물과 향과 성전 기구들을 보관하던 곳이었다. 또 하나님께서 레위 사람들과 노래하는 사람들과 문지기들에게 주라고 명령하신 곡식과 새 포도주와 올리브기름의 십분의 일, 그리고 제사장들의 몫으로 바친 예물도 그곳에 두었다.

pt.L: e lhe fez uma câmara grande, e ali antes punham a oferta de cereal, o incenso e os utensílios, e o dízimo do cereal, do vinho novo e do azeite, o mandamento dos levitas, e dos cantores, e dos porteiros, e a contribuição dos sacerdotes.
pt.B: tinha preparado para ele uma sala grande, onde antes se guardavam a oferta de cereal, o incenso e os utensílios, e também os dízimos do cereal, do vinho novo e do azeite, ordenados para os levitas, os cantores e os porteiros, e as contribuições para os sacerdotes.
pt.R: Ele deu a Tobias uma sala grande que era usada para guardar as ofertas de cereal, o incenso e os utensílios do templo. Ali também ficavam guardados a décima parte do cereal, do vinho novo e do azeite de oliva que Deus tinha mandado dar aos levitas, aos cantores e aos porteiros, e as ofertas que pertenciam aos sacerdotes.

am.L: ለእርሱም ታላቅ ክፍል አዘጋጀለት፤ በዚያም ቀድሞ የእህሉን ቁርባን፣ ነጩን ዕጣን፣ ዕቃዎቹንና የእህሉን፣ የአዲሱን የወይን ጠጅና የዘይቱን አሥራት፣ የሌዋውያኑንና የመዘምራኑን የበር ጠባቂዎቹንም ትእዛዝ፣ የካህናቱንም መባ ያስቀምጡ ነበር።
am.B: ለእርሱ ትልቅ ክፍል አዘጋጅቶለት ነበር፤ በዚያም ቀድሞ የእህል ቁርባኑን፣ ነጩን ዕጣንና ዕቃዎቹን፣ ለሌዋውያኑ፣ ለመዘምራኑና ለበር ጠባቂዎቹ የታዘዘውን የእህል፣ የአዲስ የወይን ጠጅና የወይራ ዘይት አሥራት፣ ለካህናቱ የሚሰጠውንም መባ ያስቀምጡ ነበር።
am.R: እርሱ ለጦቢያ ትልቅ ክፍል ሰጠው። ያ ክፍል የእህል ቁርባንን፣ ዕጣንንና የቤተ መቅደሱን ዕቃዎች ለማስቀመጥ ያገለግል ነበር። ደግሞም እግዚአብሔር ለሌዋውያን፣ ለመዘምራንና ለበር ጠባቂዎች እንዲሰጥ ያዘዘው የእህል፣ የአዲስ የወይን ጠጅና የወይራ ዘይት አንድ አሥረኛ፣ የካህናቱም ድርሻ የሆኑት ስጦታዎች ይቀመጡበት ነበር።

hi.L: और उसने उसके लिए एक बड़ी कोठरी बनाई, और वहाँ पहले वे अन्नबलि, लोबान, और पात्र, और अन्न, नए दाखमधु और ताज़े तेल का दशमांश, जो लेवियों और गायकों और द्वारपालों की आज्ञा [थी], और याजकों की उठाई हुई भेंट रखते थे।
hi.B: उसके लिए एक बड़ी कोठरी तैयार कर दी थी, जहाँ पहले अन्नबलि, लोबान और पात्र रखे जाते थे, और अन्न, नए दाखमधु और जैतून के तेल का वह दशमांश भी जिसकी आज्ञा लेवियों, गायकों और द्वारपालों के लिए दी गई थी, और याजकों के लिए उठाई हुई भेंटें।
hi.R: उसने तोबियाह को एक बड़ी कोठरी दे दी, जिसमें पहले अन्नबलियाँ, धूप और मंदिर के पात्र रखे जाते थे। उसमें अन्न, नए दाखमधु और जैतून के तेल का वह दसवाँ भाग भी रखा जाता था जिसे परमेश्वर ने लेवियों, गायकों और द्वारपालों को देने की आज्ञा दी थी, और वे भेंटें भी जो याजकों की थीं।

ru.L: и он сделал ему большую комнату, а туда прежде клали хлебное приношение, ладан, и сосуды, и десятину зерна, молодого вина и свежего масла, положенное по заповеди левитам, и певцам, и привратникам, и приношение священников.
ru.B: устроил для него большую комнату, где прежде хранили хлебное приношение, ладан и сосуды, а также десятину зерна, молодого вина и оливкового масла, положенную по заповеди левитам, певцам и привратникам, и приношения для священников.
ru.R: Он отдал Товии большую комнату, в которой раньше хранили хлебные приношения, благовония и храмовую утварь. Там же хранилась десятая часть зерна, молодого вина и оливкового масла, которую Бог велел отдавать левитам, певцам и привратникам, и дары, которые принадлежали священникам.

ja.L: 彼のために大きな部屋を造った。そこには以前、穀物のささげ物、乳香、器、また穀物と新しいぶどう酒と新しい油の十分の一、すなわちレビ人と歌い手と門衛たちへの命じられた[分]と、祭司たちへの献納物を置いていた。
ja.B: 彼のために大きな部屋を用意していた。そこには以前、穀物のささげ物、乳香、器、また、レビ人、歌い手、門衛のために命じられた穀物、新しいぶどう酒、オリーブ油の十分の一と、祭司たちのための献納物が置かれていた。
ja.R: エルヤシブは、トビヤに大きな部屋を使わせました。その部屋には、それまで、穀物のささげ物や香や神殿の器がしまってありました。また、神がレビ人と歌い手と門番に与えるように命じられた、穀物と新しいぶどう酒とオリーブ油の十分の一や、祭司たちのものであるささげ物も置かれていました。

decisions.choice: what the room had held
decisions.reason: The great storeroom held the gifts the people had pledged to bring (10:36-40) and that men were appointed to gather (12:44): offerings for the altar, the temple vessels, and the tithes and contributions that fed the priests, Levites, singers and gatekeepers. Clearing it for Tobiah meant those gifts had nowhere to go.

decisions.choice: the commandment of the Levites: what was commanded for them
decisions.reason: The phrase means the share commanded by law for the Levites, singers and gatekeepers (Numbers 18:21-24).

decisions.choice: new wine, fresh oil
decisions.reason: The words name the fresh produce of the vineyard and the olive grove, the usual pair in lists of tithes (Deuteronomy 14:23).

decisions.choice: incense
decisions.reason: Frankincense was a fragrant resin burned as incense (Leviticus 2:1-2); Readable uses the more common word.

decisions.choice: uma câmara grande (L); uma sala grande (B, R); o incenso (every level)
decisions.reason: For the chapter: Tobiah's room is "câmara" at Literal and "sala" at Balanced and Readable, the ordinary word for a room in a building, as the English moves from "chamber" to "room" (verses 7-9). "Incenso" covers frankincense at every level, as 1 Chronicles 9:29 has it in Portuguese.

decisions.choice: "ነጭ ዕጣን" (Literal, Balanced) for frankincense (levonah); "ዕጣን" (Readable)
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch's word for frankincense, without "ንጹሕ", which renders "pure"; the English Readable says "incense". Also verse 9.

decisions.choice: levonah "乳香" (L, B), "香" (R)
decisions.reason: As the grain offering law in Leviticus 2; R uses the plain word.

source.text: וּבְכָל־זֶ֕ה לֹ֥א הָיִ֖יתִי בִּֽירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כִּ֡י בִּשְׁנַת֩ שְׁלֹשִׁ֨ים וּשְׁתַּ֜יִם לְאַרְתַּחְשַׁ֤סְתְּא מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶל֙ בָּ֣אתִי אֶל־הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וּלְקֵ֥ץ יָמִ֖ים נִשְׁאַ֥לְתִּי מִן־הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And in all this not I was in Jerusalem, for in [the] year thirty and two of Artaxerxes king of Babylon I came to the king; and at [the] end of days I asked leave from the king,

en.L: And in all this I was not in Jerusalem, for in the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon I came to the king; and at [the] end of days I asked leave from the king,
en.B: While all this was happening I was not in Jerusalem, for in the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon I had gone to the king. After some time I asked the king for leave
en.R: All this happened while I was away from Jerusalem. In the thirty-second year that Artaxerxes was king of Babylon, I had gone back to the king. After some time I asked him to let me go,

es.L: Y en todo esto yo no estaba en Jerusalén, porque en el año treinta y dos de Artajerjes rey de Babilonia vine al rey; y al cabo de días pedí permiso al rey,
es.B: Mientras sucedía todo esto, yo no estaba en Jerusalén, porque en el año treinta y dos de Artajerjes rey de Babilonia yo había ido a ver al rey. Al cabo de un tiempo pedí permiso al rey
es.R: Todo esto pasó mientras yo estaba lejos de Jerusalén. En el año treinta y dos del reinado de Artajerjes, rey de Babilonia, yo había vuelto a la corte del rey. Al cabo de un tiempo le pedí que me dejara ir,

fr.L: Et pendant tout cela je n’étais pas à Jérusalem, car la trente-deuxième année d’Artaxerxès, roi de Babylone, je vins auprès du roi ; et au bout de [quelques] jours je demandai congé au roi,
fr.B: Pendant que tout cela se passait, je n’étais pas à Jérusalem, car la trente-deuxième année d’Artaxerxès, roi de Babylone, j’étais retourné auprès du roi. Au bout d’un certain temps, je demandai au roi la permission de partir
fr.R: Tout cela est arrivé pendant que j’étais loin de Jérusalem. La trente-deuxième année du règne d’Artaxerxès, roi de Babylone, j’étais retourné auprès du roi. Au bout d’un certain temps, je lui ai demandé de me laisser partir,

sw.L: Na katika haya yote mimi sikuwa Yerusalemu, kwa maana katika mwaka wa thelathini na mbili wa Artashasta mfalme wa Babeli nilikuja kwa mfalme; na mwisho wa siku nikaomba ruhusa kwa mfalme,
sw.B: Mambo hayo yote yalipokuwa yakitokea, mimi sikuwa Yerusalemu, kwa sababu katika mwaka wa thelathini na mbili wa Artashasta mfalme wa Babeli nilikuwa nimekwenda kwa mfalme. Baada ya muda nilimwomba mfalme ruhusa
sw.R: Mambo hayo yote yalitokea nilipokuwa mbali na Yerusalemu. Katika mwaka wa thelathini na mbili wa utawala wa Artashasta mfalme wa Babeli, nilikuwa nimerudi kwa mfalme. Baada ya muda nilimwomba aniruhusu niondoke,

vi.L: Và trong mọi việc này tôi không ở Giê-ru-sa-lem, vì vào năm thứ ba mươi hai của Ạt-ta-xét-xe vua Ba-by-lôn, tôi đến với vua; và đến cuối những ngày ấy tôi xin phép vua,
vi.B: Trong khi mọi việc ấy xảy ra, tôi không có mặt ở Giê-ru-sa-lem, vì vào năm thứ ba mươi hai đời Ạt-ta-xét-xe vua Ba-by-lôn, tôi đã trở về với vua. Sau một thời gian, tôi xin vua cho phép
vi.R: Mọi việc ấy xảy ra khi tôi đi vắng khỏi Giê-ru-sa-lem. Vào năm thứ ba mươi hai đời Ạt-ta-xét-xe làm vua Ba-by-lôn, tôi đã trở về với vua. Sau một thời gian, tôi xin vua cho tôi đi,

ko.L: 그리고 이 모든 [일이 있을] 때에 나는 예루살렘에 있지 않았다. 바빌론 왕 아닥사스다 제32년에 내가 왕에게 갔기 때문이다. 그리고 날들이 다한 끝에 나는 왕에게 [떠나기를] 청하여,
ko.B: 이 모든 일이 일어나는 동안 나는 예루살렘에 없었다. 바빌론 왕 아닥사스다 제32년에 내가 왕에게 돌아가 있었기 때문이다. 얼마 뒤에 나는 왕에게 허락을 구하여,
ko.R: 이 모든 일은 내가 예루살렘을 떠나 있을 때 일어났다. 아닥사스다가 바빌론 왕으로 있은 지 32년째 되던 해에 나는 왕에게 돌아가 있었다. 얼마 뒤에 나는 왕에게 보내 달라고 청하여,

pt.L: E em tudo isso eu não estava em Jerusalém, pois no ano trigésimo segundo de Artaxerxes, rei da Babilônia, eu fui ao rei; e ao fim de [alguns] dias pedi licença ao rei,
pt.B: Enquanto tudo isso acontecia, eu não estava em Jerusalém, pois no trigésimo segundo ano de Artaxerxes, rei da Babilônia, eu tinha ido ao rei. Algum tempo depois, pedi licença ao rei
pt.R: Tudo isso aconteceu enquanto eu estava longe de Jerusalém. No trigésimo segundo ano do reinado de Artaxerxes, rei da Babilônia, eu tinha voltado para junto do rei. Algum tempo depois, pedi que ele me deixasse ir

am.L: በዚህም ሁሉ እኔ በኢየሩሳሌም አልነበርኩም፤ በባቢሎን ንጉሥ በአርጤክስስ በሠላሳ ሁለተኛው ዓመት ወደ ንጉሡ ሄጄ ነበርና፤ በቀናቱም መጨረሻ ከንጉሡ ፈቃድ ጠየቅኩ፤
am.B: ይህ ሁሉ ሲሆን እኔ በኢየሩሳሌም አልነበርኩም፤ በባቢሎን ንጉሥ በአርጤክስስ በሠላሳ ሁለተኛው ዓመት ወደ ንጉሡ ሄጄ ነበርና። ከጥቂት ጊዜም በኋላ ንጉሡን ፈቃድ ጠየቅኩ፤
am.R: ይህ ሁሉ የሆነው እኔ ከኢየሩሳሌም ርቄ በነበርኩበት ጊዜ ነበር። አርጤክስስ የባቢሎን ንጉሥ በሆነ በሠላሳ ሁለተኛው ዓመት ወደ ንጉሡ ተመልሼ ሄጄ ነበር። ከጥቂት ጊዜ በኋላ እንዲያሰናብተኝ ንጉሡን ለመንኩት፤

hi.L: और इस सब के समय मैं यरूशलेम में नहीं था, क्योंकि बाबुल के राजा अर्तक्षत्र के बत्तीसवें वर्ष में मैं राजा के पास गया था; और दिनों के अंत में मैंने राजा से छुट्टी माँगी,
hi.B: जब यह सब हो रहा था, तब मैं यरूशलेम में नहीं था, क्योंकि बाबुल के राजा अर्तक्षत्र के बत्तीसवें वर्ष में मैं राजा के पास चला गया था। कुछ समय बाद मैंने राजा से छुट्टी माँगी
hi.R: जब यह सब हुआ, तब मैं यरूशलेम से दूर था। अर्तक्षत्र के बाबुल पर राज्य करने के बत्तीसवें वर्ष में मैं राजा के पास लौट गया था। कुछ समय बाद मैंने उससे कहा कि मुझे जाने दें,

ru.L: И во всё это [время] я не был в Иерусалиме, потому что в тридцать второй год Артаксеркса, царя Вавилона, я пришёл к царю; и через некоторое время я попросил отпуска у царя,
ru.B: Пока всё это происходило, меня не было в Иерусалиме, потому что в тридцать второй год Артаксеркса, царя Вавилона, я уехал к царю. Через некоторое время я попросил у царя позволения
ru.R: Всё это случилось, пока меня не было в Иерусалиме. В тридцать второй год правления Артаксеркса, царя Вавилона, я вернулся к царю. Через некоторое время я попросил его отпустить меня

ja.L: そして、このすべての間、わたしはエルサレムにいなかった。バビロンの王アルタクセルクセスの第三十二年に、わたしは王のもとに行ったからである。そして日々の終わりに、わたしは王に願って暇をもらい、
ja.B: このようなことが起こっていた間、わたしはエルサレムにいなかった。バビロンの王アルタクセルクセスの第三十二年に、わたしは王のもとに帰っていたのである。しばらくして、わたしは王に休暇を願い出て、
ja.R: このようなことが起こったのは、わたしがエルサレムを離れていた間のことです。アルタクセルクセスがバビロンの王になって三十二年目に、わたしは王のもとに戻っていました。しばらくたってから、わたしは王に、行かせてくださいと願い、

decisions.choice: the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes: 433 BC
decisions.reason: Nehemiah came to Jerusalem in Artaxerxes' twentieth year (2:1) and governed twelve years, until the thirty-second (5:14), which is about 433 BC. He then went back to the Persian court. Artaxerxes is called "king of Babylon" because Babylon was part of his empire, as Cyrus is in Ezra 5:13.

decisions.choice: at the end of days: after some time
decisions.reason: The phrase means after a period of time, not a stated length; it may have been a year or more. Nehemiah then came back to Jerusalem for a second term.

decisions.choice: I asked leave: I asked permission to go
decisions.reason: The verb "ask" in this form means to ask for oneself, here to ask the king's leave to return (compare 1 Samuel 20:6, 28).

decisions.choice: no ano trigésimo segundo (L); no trigésimo segundo ano (B)
decisions.reason: The order of 1:1 in Portuguese, "no ano vigésimo" at Literal and "no vigésimo ano" at Balanced, for the king's thirty-second year (m1).

decisions.choice: Nehemiah's first person: "-ኩ" after a consonant stem ("ጠየቅኩ", "አዘዝኩ"), "-ሁ" after a vowel stem ("መጣሁ", "አየሁ", "መታሁ")
decisions.reason: As docs/amharic-style.md 7b; also 12:31-40.

decisions.choice: "अर्तक्षत्र"
decisions.reason: Artaxerxes takes the established Hindi Bible form "अर्तक्षत्र", settled for Ezra and Nehemiah; he is called king of Babylon here because Babylon was part of his empire.
Nehemiah speaks to the king with आप, as people address a king in the history note; Readable gives the request in indirect speech with the respectful "दें".

decisions.choice: "Артаксеркс"
decisions.reason: The traditional Russian form of the Persian king's name, kept with Ezra and Nehemiah 1-6; "царь Вавилона" follows the Hebrew title.

decisions.choice: "バビロンの王アルタクセルクセス" (L, B); R "アルタクセルクセスがバビロンの王になって三十二年目に"
decisions.reason: Artaxerxes as Ezra and NEH-1; the Persian king is called king of Babylon here, and the wording keeps that.

source.text: וָאָב֖וֹא לִֽירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וָאָבִ֣ינָה בָרָעָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֤ה אֶלְיָשִׁיב֙ לְט֣וֹבִיָּ֔ה לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת לוֹ֙ נִשְׁכָּ֔ה בְּחַצְרֵ֖י בֵּ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: and I came to Jerusalem, and I understood about the evil that had done Eliashib for Tobiah, to make for him a chamber in [the] courts of [the] house of God.

en.L: and I came to Jerusalem, and I understood the evil that Eliashib had done for Tobiah, in making a chamber for him in the courts of the house of God.
en.B: and came to Jerusalem. Then I learned of the evil Eliashib had done for Tobiah by giving him a room in the courts of the house of God.
en.R: and came back to Jerusalem. There I found out about the evil thing Eliashib had done. He had given Tobiah a room in the courtyards of God's temple.

es.L: y vine a Jerusalén, y entendí el mal que Eliasib había hecho en favor de Tobías, al hacerle una cámara en los atrios de la casa de Dios.
es.B: y vine a Jerusalén. Entonces me enteré del mal que Eliasib había hecho en favor de Tobías al darle una habitación en los atrios de la casa de Dios.
es.R: y regresé a Jerusalén. Allí descubrí el mal que había hecho Eliasib. Le había dado a Tobías una habitación en los patios del templo de Dios.

fr.L: et je vins à Jérusalem, et je compris le mal qu’Éliashib avait fait en faveur de Tobiya, en lui faisant une chambre dans les parvis de la maison de Dieu.
fr.B: et je vins à Jérusalem. Je découvris alors le mal qu’Éliashib avait fait en faveur de Tobiya en lui donnant une chambre dans les parvis de la maison de Dieu.
fr.R: et je suis revenu à Jérusalem. Là, j’ai découvert la mauvaise action d’Éliashib. Il avait donné à Tobiya une salle dans les cours du temple de Dieu.

sw.L: nikaja Yerusalemu, nikafahamu ubaya ambao Eliashibu alikuwa amemfanyia Tobia, kwa kumtengenezea chumba katika nyua za nyumba ya Mungu.
sw.B: nikaja Yerusalemu. Ndipo nikafahamu ubaya ambao Eliashibu alikuwa ameufanya kwa ajili ya Tobia kwa kumpa chumba katika nyua za nyumba ya Mungu.
sw.R: nikarudi Yerusalemu. Huko niligundua jambo baya ambalo Eliashibu alikuwa amefanya. Alikuwa amempa Tobia chumba katika nyua za hekalu la Mungu.

vi.L: và tôi đến Giê-ru-sa-lem, và tôi hiểu điều ác mà Ê-li-a-síp đã làm cho Tô-bi-gia, khi làm cho người ấy một phòng trong các sân của nhà Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: và đến Giê-ru-sa-lem. Bấy giờ tôi mới biết điều ác Ê-li-a-síp đã làm vì Tô-bi-gia, khi cho người ấy một phòng trong các sân của nhà Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: và trở về Giê-ru-sa-lem. Tại đó tôi biết được việc xấu Ê-li-a-síp đã làm. Ông đã cho Tô-bi-gia một phòng trong các sân của đền thờ Đức Chúa Trời.

ko.L: 예루살렘에 왔다. 그리고 엘리아십이 도비야를 위해 행한 악, 곧 하나님의 집 뜰들에 그를 위해 방을 만든 일을 깨달았다.
ko.B: 예루살렘으로 왔다. 그리고 엘리아십이 도비야를 위해 하나님의 집 뜰에 방을 내준 악한 일을 알게 되었다.
ko.R: 예루살렘으로 돌아왔다. 그곳에서 나는 엘리아십이 저지른 악한 일을 알게 되었다. 그가 하나님의 성전 뜰에 도비야가 쓸 방을 내준 것이다.

pt.L: e vim a Jerusalém, e entendi o mal que Eliasibe tinha feito por Tobias, fazendo-lhe uma câmara nos pátios da casa de Deus.
pt.B: e vim a Jerusalém. Então fiquei sabendo do mal que Eliasibe tinha feito em favor de Tobias, dando-lhe uma sala nos pátios da casa de Deus.
pt.R: e voltei para Jerusalém. Ali descobri a coisa má que Eliasibe tinha feito. Ele tinha dado a Tobias uma sala nos pátios do templo de Deus.

am.L: ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም መጣሁ፤ ኤልያሴብ ለጦቢያ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት አደባባዮች ክፍል በማዘጋጀት ያደረገውን ክፉ ነገር አስተዋልኩ።
am.B: ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም መጣሁ። ከዚያም ኤልያሴብ ለጦቢያ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት አደባባዮች ክፍል በመስጠት የፈጸመውን ክፉ ነገር ተረዳሁ።
am.R: ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም ተመለስኩ። በዚያም ኤልያሴብ ያደረገውን ክፉ ነገር አወቅኩ። እርሱ በእግዚአብሔር ቤተ መቅደስ አደባባዮች ውስጥ ለጦቢያ ክፍል ሰጥቶት ነበር።

hi.L: और मैं यरूशलेम आया, और मैंने उस बुराई को समझा जो एल्याशीब ने तोबियाह के लिए की थी, कि परमेश्वर के भवन के आँगनों में उसके लिए एक कोठरी बनाई।
hi.B: और यरूशलेम आया। तब मुझे उस बुराई का पता चला जो एल्याशीब ने तोबियाह के लिए की थी, कि उसने परमेश्वर के भवन के आँगनों में उसे एक कोठरी दे दी थी।
hi.R: और यरूशलेम लौट आया। वहाँ मुझे उस बुरे काम का पता चला जो एल्याशीब ने किया था। उसने तोबियाह को परमेश्वर के मंदिर के आँगनों में एक कोठरी दे दी थी।

ru.L: и пришёл я в Иерусалим, и понял зло, которое сделал Елиашив для Товии, устроив ему комнату во дворах дома Божьего.
ru.B: и пришёл в Иерусалим. Тогда я узнал о зле, которое Елиашив сделал для Товии, отдав ему комнату во дворах дома Божьего.
ru.R: и вернулся в Иерусалим. Там я узнал о том зле, которое сделал Елиашив. Он отдал Товии комнату во дворах храма Божьего.

ja.L: エルサレムに来た。そして、エルヤシブがトビヤのためにした悪、すなわち神の家の庭に彼のために部屋を造ったことを悟った。
ja.B: エルサレムに戻った。そして、エルヤシブがトビヤのために行った悪事、すなわち神の家の庭にある部屋を彼に与えたことを知った。
ja.R: エルサレムに戻って来ました。そこで、エルヤシブがした悪いことを知りました。エルヤシブは、神の神殿の庭にある部屋をトビヤに与えていたのです。

decisions.choice: the courts of the house of God
decisions.reason: The temple was surrounded by courtyards with rooms built around them, used for storage and for the priests (Ezekiel 40:17; 1 Chronicles 28:12). To give one to Tobiah, an Ammonite, was to bring into the holy place a man the law kept out of the assembly (verse 1).

decisions.choice: evil: a wrong, an outrage
decisions.reason: The word covers both moral wrong and harm. Nehemiah calls Eliashib's act a wrong because it broke the law and robbed the Levites of their storeroom (verses 5, 10).

decisions.choice: God's temple
decisions.reason: Readable's wording for "the house of God".

source.text: וַיֵּ֥רַֽע לִ֖י מְאֹ֑ד וָֽאַשְׁלִ֜יכָה אֶֽת־כָּל־כְּלֵ֧י בֵית־טוֹבִיָּ֛ה הַח֖וּץ מִן־הַלִּשְׁכָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was evil to me very much, and I threw all [the] vessels of [the] house of Tobiah outside from the chamber.

en.L: And it was very evil to me, and I threw all the vessels of the house of Tobiah outside, out of the chamber.
en.B: I was very displeased, and I threw all of Tobiah's household goods out of the room.
en.R: I was very angry. I threw all of Tobiah's furniture and belongings out of the room.

es.L: Y me pareció muy mal, y arrojé fuera de la cámara todos los enseres de la casa de Tobías.
es.B: Me disgustó mucho, y arrojé fuera de la habitación todos los enseres de la casa de Tobías.
es.R: Me enojé mucho. Tiré fuera de la habitación todos los muebles y las cosas de Tobías.

fr.L: Et cela fut très mal à mes yeux, et je jetai dehors, hors de la chambre, tous les objets de la maison de Tobiya.
fr.B: J’en fus très mécontent, et je jetai hors de la chambre tous les meubles de Tobiya.
fr.R: J’étais très en colère. J’ai jeté hors de la salle tous les meubles et toutes les affaires de Tobiya.

sw.L: Nalo likawa baya sana kwangu, nikavitupa nje vyombo vyote vya nyumba ya Tobia, nje ya chumba.
sw.B: Nilichukizwa sana, nikavitupa nje ya chumba vyombo vyote vya nyumbani vya Tobia.
sw.R: Nilikasirika sana. Nilitupa nje ya chumba samani na vitu vyote vya Tobia.

vi.L: Và điều ấy rất xấu trong mắt tôi, và tôi ném tất cả đồ đạc của nhà Tô-bi-gia ra ngoài, ra khỏi phòng.
vi.B: Tôi rất bất bình, và ném tất cả đồ đạc trong nhà của Tô-bi-gia ra khỏi phòng.
vi.R: Tôi rất tức giận. Tôi ném hết bàn ghế và đồ đạc của Tô-bi-gia ra khỏi phòng.

ko.L: 그것이 내게 매우 악하게 [보였으므로], 나는 도비야의 집 기구들을 모두 그 방에서 밖으로 내던졌다.
ko.B: 나는 몹시 언짢아서, 도비야의 살림살이를 모두 그 방 밖으로 내던졌다.
ko.R: 나는 몹시 화가 났다. 그래서 도비야의 가구와 물건들을 모두 그 방 밖으로 내던졌다.

pt.L: E isso me pareceu muito mal, e lancei para fora da câmara todos os utensílios da casa de Tobias.
pt.B: Fiquei muito desgostoso e joguei para fora da sala todos os objetos da casa de Tobias.
pt.R: Fiquei muito irritado. Joguei para fora da sala todos os móveis e objetos de Tobias.

am.L: ይህም እጅግ ክፉ ሆነብኝ፤ የጦቢያንም ቤት ዕቃዎች ሁሉ ከክፍሉ ወደ ውጭ ጣልኩ።
am.B: ነገሩ እጅግ አላስደሰተኝም፤ የጦቢያንም የቤት ዕቃዎች ሁሉ ከክፍሉ አውጥቼ ጣልኩ።
am.R: እጅግ ተቆጣሁ። የጦቢያን የቤት ዕቃዎችና ንብረቶች ሁሉ ከክፍሉ አውጥቼ ጣልኩ።

hi.L: और यह मुझे बहुत बुरा लगा, और मैंने तोबियाह के घर का सारा सामान कोठरी से बाहर फेंक दिया।
hi.B: मुझे यह बहुत बुरा लगा, और मैंने तोबियाह के घर का सारा सामान उस कोठरी से बाहर फेंक दिया।
hi.R: मुझे बहुत क्रोध आया। मैंने तोबियाह का सारा फ़र्नीचर और सामान उस कोठरी से बाहर फेंक दिया।

ru.L: И было мне очень худо, и я выбросил все вещи дома Товии вон из комнаты.
ru.B: Мне это очень не понравилось, и я выбросил все домашние вещи Товии из комнаты.
ru.R: Я очень рассердился. Я выбросил из комнаты всю мебель и вещи Товии.

ja.L: それはわたしにとって非常に悪いことであった。わたしはトビヤの家の器をことごとく部屋から外に投げ出した。
ja.B: わたしはひどく不快に思い、トビヤの家財道具をすべて部屋から外へ投げ出した。
ja.R: わたしはとても腹を立てました。そして、トビヤの家具や持ち物を、全部、部屋から外に投げ出しました。

decisions.choice: it was evil to me: I was greatly displeased
decisions.reason: The Hebrew uses the same word as verse 7: the wrong done was a wrong in Nehemiah's eyes too, and it angered him (compare 2:10, where the same idiom describes Tobiah's displeasure).

decisions.choice: the vessels of the house of Tobiah: his household goods
decisions.reason: "Vessels" means any articles or furnishings; with "house" it means the furniture and belongings Tobiah kept in the room.

decisions.choice: very angry
decisions.reason: Readable says the feeling in plain words.

decisions.choice: isso me pareceu muito mal (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the word "mal" of verse 7, as the Hebrew repeats it (m1): the wrong done was a wrong in Nehemiah's eyes. Balanced and Readable say the feeling.

source.text: וָאֹ֣מְרָ֔ה וַֽיְטַהֲר֖וּ הַלְּשָׁכ֑וֹת וָאָשִׁ֣יבָה שָּׁ֗ם כְּלֵי֙ בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים אֶת־הַמִּנְחָ֖ה וְהַלְּבוֹנָֽה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And I said, and they purified the chambers, and I brought back there [the] vessels of [the] house of God, the grain offering and the frankincense.

en.L: And I said, and they purified the chambers, and I brought back there the vessels of the house of God, the grain offering and the frankincense.
en.B: Then I gave orders, and they purified the rooms. I brought back into them the utensils of the house of God, with the grain offerings and the frankincense.
en.R: Then I gave orders for the rooms to be made ritually clean. After that I put the temple utensils back in them, with the grain offerings and the incense.

es.L: Y dije, y purificaron las cámaras, y volví a poner allí los utensilios de la casa de Dios, la ofrenda de cereal y el incienso.
es.B: Luego di órdenes, y purificaron las habitaciones. Volví a poner en ellas los utensilios de la casa de Dios, con las ofrendas de cereal y el incienso.
es.R: Después mandé que purificaran las habitaciones según el ritual. Luego volví a poner en ellas los utensilios del templo, con las ofrendas de cereal y el incienso.

fr.L: Et je dis, et ils purifièrent les chambres, et je remis là les ustensiles de la maison de Dieu, l’offrande végétale et l’encens.
fr.B: Puis je donnai des ordres, et l’on purifia les chambres. J’y remis les ustensiles de la maison de Dieu, avec les offrandes végétales et l’encens.
fr.R: Ensuite, j’ai ordonné qu’on purifie les salles selon les règles du culte. Puis j’y ai remis les ustensiles du temple, avec les offrandes de céréales et l’encens.

sw.L: Nikasema, nao wakavitakasa vyumba, nikarudisha humo vyombo vya nyumba ya Mungu, sadaka ya nafaka na ubani.
sw.B: Kisha nilitoa amri, nao wakavitakasa vyumba hivyo. Nikarudisha humo vyombo vya nyumba ya Mungu, pamoja na sadaka za nafaka na ubani.
sw.R: Kisha niliamuru vyumba hivyo vifanywe safi kwa taratibu za ibada. Baadaye nikarudisha humo vyombo vya hekalu, pamoja na sadaka za nafaka na ubani.

vi.L: Và tôi nói, và họ thanh tẩy các phòng, và tôi đem trở lại đó các vật dụng của nhà Đức Chúa Trời, tế lễ ngũ cốc và nhũ hương.
vi.B: Rồi tôi ra lệnh, và người ta thanh tẩy các phòng. Tôi đem các vật dụng của nhà Đức Chúa Trời trở lại đó, cùng với các tế lễ ngũ cốc và nhũ hương.
vi.R: Rồi tôi ra lệnh làm cho các phòng ấy được tinh sạch theo nghi lễ. Sau đó tôi đem các vật dụng của đền thờ, cùng các tế lễ ngũ cốc và nhũ hương, đặt trở lại trong đó.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 말하여, 그들이 그 방들을 정결하게 했고, 나는 하나님의 집 기구들과 곡식 제물과 유향을 그곳에 다시 들여놓았다.
ko.B: 그런 다음 내가 명령하여 그 방들을 정결하게 하고, 하나님의 집 기구들과 곡식 제물과 유향을 그곳에 다시 들여놓았다.
ko.R: 그리고 나는 예식에 따라 그 방들을 깨끗하게 하라고 명령했다. 그 뒤에 성전 기구들과 곡식 제물과 향을 다시 그 방들에 들여놓았다.

pt.L: E eu disse, e purificaram as câmaras, e trouxe de volta para ali os utensílios da casa de Deus, a oferta de cereal e o incenso.
pt.B: Então dei ordens, e eles purificaram as salas. Depois trouxe de volta para elas os utensílios da casa de Deus, com as ofertas de cereal e o incenso.
pt.R: Depois dei ordens para que as salas fossem purificadas segundo os ritos da Lei. Então pus de volta nelas os utensílios do templo, com as ofertas de cereal e o incenso.

am.L: እኔም አዘዝኩ፤ ክፍሎቹንም አነጹ፤ የእግዚአብሔርንም ቤት ዕቃዎች፣ የእህሉን ቁርባንና ነጩን ዕጣን ወደዚያ መለስኩ።
am.B: ከዚያም ትእዛዝ ሰጠሁ፤ ክፍሎቹንም አነጹ። የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ዕቃዎች ከእህል ቁርባኑና ከነጩ ዕጣን ጋር ወደ ውስጣቸው መለስኩ።
am.R: ከዚያም ክፍሎቹ በሥርዓቱ መሠረት እንዲነጹ አዘዝኩ። ከዚያ በኋላ የቤተ መቅደሱን ዕቃዎች ከእህል ቁርባኑና ከዕጣኑ ጋር ወደ ክፍሎቹ መለስኩ።

hi.L: और मैंने कहा, और उन्होंने कोठरियों को शुद्ध किया, और मैं परमेश्वर के भवन के पात्रों को, अन्नबलि और लोबान को, वहाँ फिर ले आया।
hi.B: फिर मैंने आज्ञा दी, और उन्होंने कोठरियों को शुद्ध किया। मैं परमेश्वर के भवन के पात्रों को, अन्नबलियों और लोबान के साथ, उनमें फिर ले आया।
hi.R: फिर मैंने आज्ञा दी कि उन कोठरियों को विधि के अनुसार शुद्ध किया जाए। उसके बाद मैंने मंदिर के पात्रों को, अन्नबलियों और धूप के साथ, उनमें फिर रख दिया।

ru.L: И я сказал, и очистили комнаты, и я вернул туда сосуды дома Божьего, хлебное приношение и ладан.
ru.B: Потом я дал распоряжение, и комнаты очистили. Я вернул туда утварь дома Божьего, хлебные приношения и ладан.
ru.R: Потом я приказал совершить над комнатами обряд очищения. После этого я снова поставил туда храмовую утварь, хлебные приношения и благовония.

ja.L: そして、わたしが命じると、彼らは部屋を清めた。わたしはそこに、神の家の器と、穀物のささげ物と乳香を戻した。
ja.B: そして、わたしが命じたので、人々は部屋を清めた。わたしは神の家の器を、穀物のささげ物と乳香と共に、そこに戻した。
ja.R: それから、わたしは命じて、その部屋を清めさせました。そして、神殿の器を、穀物のささげ物や香と一緒に、元の場所に戻しました。

decisions.choice: they purified the chambers
decisions.reason: The rooms were made ritually clean after the use Tobiah had made of them, before the holy things were brought back. Nehemiah speaks of "chambers", plural: more rooms than the one large room may have been affected.

decisions.choice: I said: I gave orders
decisions.reason: "Said" is often used for a command given by a person in authority (Esther 1:10; Nehemiah 13:19, 22).

decisions.choice: incense
decisions.reason: As in verse 5.

source.text: וָאֵ֣דְעָ֔ה כִּֽי־מְנָי֥וֹת הַלְוִיִּ֖ם לֹ֣א נִתָּ֑נָה וַיִּבְרְח֧וּ אִישׁ־לְשָׂדֵ֛הוּ הַלְוִיִּ֥ם וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִ֖ים עֹשֵׂ֥י הַמְּלָאכָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And I knew that [the] portions of the Levites not had been given, and fled each to his field, the Levites and the singers doing the work.

en.L: And I knew that the portions of the Levites had not been given, and they had fled, each to his field, the Levites and the singers doing the work.
en.B: I also learned that the portions of the Levites had not been given, so that the Levites and the singers who did the work had fled, each to his own field.
en.R: I also found out that the Levites had not been given their share of the food. So the Levites and singers who served in the temple had left and gone back to work their own fields.

es.L: Y supe que las porciones de los levitas no se les habían dado, y habían huido cada uno a su campo, los levitas y los cantores que hacían el servicio.
es.B: Supe también que no se les habían dado sus porciones a los levitas, de modo que los levitas y los cantores que hacían el servicio habían huido, cada uno a su campo.
es.R: También descubrí que no se les había dado a los levitas su parte de los alimentos. Por eso los levitas y los cantores que servían en el templo se habían ido y habían vuelto a trabajar sus propios campos.

fr.L: Et j’appris que les parts des Lévites n’avaient pas été données, et qu’ils s’étaient enfuis chacun vers son champ, les Lévites et les chanteurs qui faisaient le service.
fr.B: J’appris aussi que les parts des Lévites ne leur avaient pas été données, si bien que les Lévites et les chanteurs qui faisaient le service s’étaient enfuis, chacun dans son champ.
fr.R: J’ai aussi découvert qu’on n’avait pas donné aux Lévites leur part de nourriture. Alors les Lévites et les chanteurs qui servaient dans le temple étaient partis pour retourner travailler leurs propres champs.

sw.L: Nikajua kwamba mafungu ya Walawi hayakuwa yametolewa, nao walikuwa wamekimbia, kila mtu shambani kwake, Walawi na waimbaji waliofanya kazi.
sw.B: Pia nilijua kwamba Walawi hawakuwa wamepewa mafungu yao, hata Walawi na waimbaji waliofanya huduma walikuwa wamekimbia, kila mmoja shambani kwake.
sw.R: Pia niligundua kwamba Walawi hawakuwa wamepewa fungu lao la chakula. Kwa hiyo Walawi na waimbaji waliohudumu hekaluni walikuwa wameondoka, wakarudi kulima mashamba yao wenyewe.

vi.L: Và tôi biết rằng các phần của người Lê-vi đã không được cấp, và họ đã bỏ trốn, mỗi người về ruộng mình, những người Lê-vi và những người ca hát làm công việc.
vi.B: Tôi cũng biết rằng người Lê-vi đã không được cấp phần của mình, nên những người Lê-vi và những người ca hát lo công việc phục vụ đã bỏ đi, ai về ruộng nấy.
vi.R: Tôi cũng biết được rằng người Lê-vi không được nhận phần lương thực của họ. Vì vậy, những người Lê-vi và những người ca hát phục vụ trong đền thờ đã bỏ đi và trở về làm ruộng của mình.

ko.L: 그리고 나는 레위 사람들의 몫이 주어지지 않아서, 그 일을 하는 레위 사람들과 노래하는 사람들이 각자 자기 밭으로 도망간 것을 알았다.
ko.B: 나는 또 레위 사람들이 자기 몫을 받지 못하여, 일을 맡은 레위 사람들과 노래하는 사람들이 저마다 자기 밭으로 달아나 버린 것을 알게 되었다.
ko.R: 나는 또 레위 사람들이 먹을 몫을 받지 못했다는 것도 알게 되었다. 그래서 성전에서 섬기던 레위 사람들과 노래하는 사람들이 일을 그만두고 저마다 자기 밭을 갈러 돌아가 버렸던 것이다.

pt.L: E soube que as porções dos levitas não tinham sido dadas, e que tinham fugido, cada um para o seu campo, os levitas e os cantores que faziam a obra.
pt.B: Também fiquei sabendo que as porções dos levitas não tinham sido entregues, de modo que os levitas e os cantores que faziam o serviço tinham fugido, cada um para o seu próprio campo.
pt.R: Também descobri que os levitas não tinham recebido a sua parte dos alimentos. Por isso os levitas e os cantores que serviam no templo tinham ido embora, de volta para trabalhar nos seus próprios campos.

am.L: የሌዋውያኑም ድርሻ እንዳልተሰጠ አወቅኩ፤ ሥራውንም የሚሠሩ ሌዋውያኑና መዘምራኑ እያንዳንዳቸው ወደ እርሻቸው ሸሽተው ነበር።
am.B: ደግሞም የሌዋውያኑ ድርሻ እንዳልተሰጣቸው ተረዳሁ፤ ስለዚህም ሥራውን የሚሠሩት ሌዋውያኑና መዘምራኑ እያንዳንዳቸው ወደ ገዛ እርሻቸው ሸሽተው ነበር።
am.R: ደግሞም ሌዋውያኑ የምግብ ድርሻቸውን እንዳልተቀበሉ አወቅኩ። ስለዚህ በቤተ መቅደሱ የሚያገለግሉት ሌዋውያንና መዘምራን ሥራቸውን ትተው የገዛ እርሻቸውን ለመሥራት ተመልሰው ነበር።

hi.L: और मुझे पता चला कि लेवियों के भाग नहीं दिए गए थे, और लेवी और गायक जो काम करते थे, हर एक अपने खेत को भाग गए थे।
hi.B: मुझे यह भी पता चला कि लेवियों के भाग उन्हें नहीं दिए गए थे, इसलिए काम करनेवाले लेवी और गायक अपने-अपने खेत को भाग गए थे।
hi.R: मुझे यह भी पता चला कि लेवियों को भोजन का उनका भाग नहीं दिया गया था। इसलिए जो लेवी और गायक मंदिर में सेवा करते थे, वे छोड़कर अपने-अपने खेत जोतने लौट गए थे।

ru.L: И я узнал, что доли левитов не давались, и разбежались каждый на своё поле левиты и певцы, исполнявшие работу.
ru.B: Я также узнал, что левитам не давали их долей, так что левиты и певцы, исполнявшие служение, разошлись каждый на своё поле.
ru.R: Я также узнал, что левитам не давали их долю пищи. Поэтому левиты и певцы, которые служили в храме, ушли и вернулись работать на свои поля.

ja.L: また、わたしは、レビ人たちの分け前が与えられていなかったことを知った。それで、務めを行うレビ人たちと歌い手たちは、おのおの自分の畑に逃げてしまっていた。
ja.B: また、わたしは、レビ人たちの分け前が与えられていなかったことを知った。そのため、務めを果たすべきレビ人と歌い手たちは、それぞれ自分の畑に逃げ帰っていた。
ja.R: また、レビ人たちが、自分たちの分の食べ物を受け取っていなかったこともわかりました。そのため、神殿で働いていたレビ人と歌い手たちは、自分の畑を耕すために、それぞれ家に帰ってしまっていました。

decisions.choice: each to his field: back to farming to live
decisions.reason: The Levites had no tribal land, only towns with pasture land around them (Numbers 35:2-5), and lived from the tithes (Numbers 18:21). With no tithes coming in, they had to farm to feed their families, and the temple's work was left undone.

decisions.choice: the portions not given: the pledge broken
decisions.reason: The people had pledged to bring the tithes to the Levites (10:38-40), and in Zerubbabel's and Nehemiah's days they had given them (12:47). Nehemiah now finds that this had stopped.

decisions.choice: doing the work: serving in the temple
decisions.reason: "The work" here is the service of the house of God (compare 11:12, 22).

decisions.choice: as porções dos levitas (L, B); a sua parte dos alimentos (R)
decisions.reason: The word of 12:44 and 12:47, "porções", for the shares the law gave the Levites (m2), so that the reader sees the pledge of 10:38-40 broken; Readable says what the share was.

source.text: וָאָרִ֨יבָה֙ אֶת־הַסְּגָנִ֔ים וָאֹ֣מְרָ֔ה מַדּ֖וּעַ נֶעֱזַ֣ב בֵּית־הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וָֽאֶ֨קְבְּצֵ֔םוָֽאַעֲמִדֵ֖ם עַל־עָמְדָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And I contended with the officials and I said: Why is forsaken [the] house of God? And I gathered them and I stationed them at their place.

en.L: And I contended with the officials and said, "Why is the house of God forsaken?" And I gathered them and stationed them at their place.
en.B: So I contended with the officials and said, "Why is the house of God forsaken?" And I gathered the Levites and singers and set them at their posts.
en.R: So I took the officials to task. I asked them, "Why has God's temple been neglected?" Then I called the Levites and singers back and put them back at their posts.

es.L: Y contendí con los oficiales y dije: «¿Por qué está abandonada la casa de Dios?». Y los reuní y los puse en su lugar.
es.B: Entonces reprendí a los oficiales y dije: «¿Por qué está abandonada la casa de Dios?». Y reuní a los levitas y a los cantores y los puse en sus puestos.
es.R: Entonces llamé la atención a los funcionarios. Les pregunté: «¿Por qué se ha descuidado el templo de Dios?». Luego volví a llamar a los levitas y a los cantores y los puse otra vez en sus puestos.

fr.L: Et je m’en pris aux magistrats et je dis : « Pourquoi la maison de Dieu est-elle abandonnée ? » Et je les rassemblai et les rétablis à leur place.
fr.B: Alors je fis des reproches aux magistrats et je dis : « Pourquoi la maison de Dieu est-elle abandonnée ? » Puis je rassemblai les Lévites et les chanteurs et je les remis à leurs postes.
fr.R: Alors j’ai fait des reproches aux responsables. Je leur ai demandé : « Pourquoi a-t-on négligé le temple de Dieu ? » Ensuite, j’ai rappelé les Lévites et les chanteurs et je les ai remis à leurs postes.

sw.L: Nikabishana na maafisa, nikasema, "Kwa nini nyumba ya Mungu imeachwa?" Nikawakusanya, nikawasimamisha mahali pao.
sw.B: Basi niliwalaumu maafisa, nikasema, "Kwa nini nyumba ya Mungu imeachwa?" Nikawakusanya Walawi na waimbaji, nikawarudisha kwenye nafasi zao.
sw.R: Basi niliwakemea maafisa. Niliwauliza, "Kwa nini hekalu la Mungu limetelekezwa?" Kisha nikawaita tena Walawi na waimbaji, nikawarudisha kwenye kazi zao.

vi.L: Và tôi trách cứ các quan chức và nói: "Tại sao nhà của Đức Chúa Trời bị bỏ bê?" Và tôi nhóm họ lại và đặt họ vào chỗ của họ.
vi.B: Vì vậy tôi khiển trách các quan chức và nói: "Tại sao nhà của Đức Chúa Trời bị bỏ bê như vậy?" Rồi tôi tập hợp những người Lê-vi và những người ca hát lại, và đặt họ vào vị trí của mình.
vi.R: Vì vậy tôi trách các quan chức. Tôi hỏi họ: "Sao các ông lại để đền thờ của Đức Chúa Trời bị bỏ bê?" Rồi tôi gọi những người Lê-vi và những người ca hát trở về, và cho họ trở lại chỗ làm việc của mình.

ko.L: 그리고 나는 관리들을 꾸짖으며 말했다. "어찌하여 하나님의 집이 버려졌소?" 그리고 나는 그들을 모아 그들의 자리에 세웠다.
ko.B: 그래서 나는 관리들을 꾸짖으며 말했다. "어찌하여 하나님의 집이 버려져 있소?" 그리고 레위 사람들과 노래하는 사람들을 모아 그들의 자리에 세웠다.
ko.R: 그래서 나는 관리들을 나무랐다. 나는 그들에게 "어째서 하나님의 성전을 이렇게 내버려 두었소?" 하고 물었다. 그런 다음 레위 사람들과 노래하는 사람들을 다시 불러 모아 제자리에서 일하게 했다.

pt.L: E contendi com os oficiais e disse: "Por que a casa de Deus está abandonada?" E os reuni e os coloquei no seu posto.
pt.B: Então repreendi os oficiais e disse: "Por que a casa de Deus foi abandonada?" Depois reuni os levitas e os cantores e os coloquei nos seus postos.
pt.R: Então chamei a atenção dos oficiais. Eu perguntei: "Por que o templo de Deus foi descuidado?" Depois chamei de volta os levitas e os cantores e os pus de novo nos seus postos.

am.L: ከሹማምንቱም ጋር ተከራከርኩ፤ እንዲህም አልኩ፦ «የእግዚአብሔር ቤት ስለ ምን ተተወ?» ሰበሰብኳቸውም፤ በስፍራቸውም አቆምኳቸው።
am.B: ስለዚህ ከሹማምንቱ ጋር ተከራከርኩ፤ «የእግዚአብሔር ቤት ስለ ምን ተተወ?» አልኳቸው። ሌዋውያኑንና መዘምራኑን ሰብስቤ በየሥራ ቦታቸው አቆምኳቸው።
am.R: ስለዚህ ሹማምንቱን ወቀስኳቸው። «የእግዚአብሔር ቤተ መቅደስ ለምን ቸል ተባለ?» ብዬ ጠየቅኋቸው። ከዚያም ሌዋውያኑንና መዘምራኑን መልሼ ጠርቼ በየሥራ ቦታቸው መለስኳቸው።

hi.L: और मैंने अधिकारियों से वाद-विवाद किया और कहा, "परमेश्वर का भवन क्यों त्यागा गया है?" और मैंने उन्हें इकट्ठा किया और उन्हें उनके स्थान पर खड़ा किया।
hi.B: तब मैंने अधिकारियों को डाँटा और कहा, "परमेश्वर का भवन क्यों त्यागा गया है?" और मैंने लेवियों और गायकों को इकट्ठा करके उन्हें उनके पदों पर ठहराया।
hi.R: तब मैंने अधिकारियों को फटकारा। मैंने उनसे पूछा, "परमेश्वर के मंदिर की उपेक्षा क्यों की गई है?" फिर मैंने लेवियों और गायकों को वापस बुलाया और उन्हें फिर से उनके पदों पर लगाया।

ru.L: И я спорил с начальниками и сказал: «Почему оставлен дом Божий?» И я собрал их и поставил их на их место.
ru.B: Тогда я упрекнул начальников и сказал: «Почему оставлен дом Божий?» И я собрал левитов и певцов и поставил их на их места.
ru.R: Тогда я строго поговорил с начальниками. Я спросил их: «Почему храм Божий оставлен без заботы?» Потом я снова собрал левитов и певцов и вернул их на их места.

ja.L: そこで、わたしは役人たちを責めて言った。「なぜ神の家は捨てられているのか。」そして、わたしは彼らを集め、彼らをその持ち場に立たせた。
ja.B: そこで、わたしは役人たちを責めて言った。「なぜ神の家がなおざりにされているのか。」そして、わたしはレビ人と歌い手たちを集め、それぞれの持ち場に就かせた。
ja.R: そこで、わたしは役人たちを責めて、「なぜ神の神殿がおろそかにされているのか」と言いました。それから、レビ人と歌い手たちを呼び戻して、それぞれの持ち場に戻らせました。

decisions.choice: contended: brought a complaint against
decisions.reason: The verb is used of bringing a case or accusation against someone (also verses 17, 25). Nehemiah charges the leaders with failing in their duty.

decisions.choice: the house of God forsaken: the pledge of 10:40
decisions.reason: The people had ended their pledge with "we will not forsake the house of our God" (10:40); Nehemiah's question uses the same verb.

decisions.choice: them: the Levites and singers
decisions.reason: Those gathered and stationed are the Levites and singers who had left (verse 10), not the officials.

decisions.choice: the Levites and singers
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name who "them" are, from verse 10.

decisions.choice: contendi (L); repreendi (B); chamei a atenção (R)
decisions.reason: For the chapter (verses 11, 17, 25): the verb is used of bringing a charge against someone (m1). Literal says "contender", the old word for a dispute at law; Balanced "repreender", what Nehemiah does as governor; Readable "chamar a atenção", as the English Readable says "took to task".

decisions.choice: abandonada (L, B); descuidado (R)
decisions.reason: Nehemiah takes up the last words of the pledge, "não abandonaremos" (10:40, m2). Literal and Balanced repeat "abandonar", as the English says "forsaken"; Readable says "descuidar", its word in 10:40.

decisions.choice: "ተከራከርኩ" (Literal, Balanced) for "contended" (riv), "ወቀስኳቸው" (Readable, "took to task"); also verses 17 and 25
decisions.reason: Nehemiah brings a complaint against them, as the meaning decision says; "ተጣላ" would suggest a brawl. "ሹማምንት" for the officials (seganim), as the terms list.

decisions.choice: "ተተወ" (Literal, Balanced), echoing the pledge "አንተውም" of 10:40 (Literal); "ቸል ተባለ" (Readable), as 10:40 (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The question picks up the words of the pledge the people broke.

decisions.choice: "तुम" from Nehemiah to the officials and nobles
decisions.reason: Nehemiah speaks as governor to those under him, so he says तुम to the officials, the nobles (verse 17) and the traders (verse 21), and तू when he prays to God.

decisions.choice: ne'ezav "捨てられている" (L), "なおざりにされている" (B), "おろそかにされている" (R)
decisions.reason: Echoes the pledge of 10:40, where the same verb is なおざりにしない (B), おろそかにしません (R).

decisions.choice: seganim "役人たち" at every level

source.text: וְכָל־יְהוּדָ֗ה הֵבִ֜יאוּ מַעְשַׂ֧ר הַדָּגָ֛ן וְהַתִּיר֥וֹשׁ וְהַיִּצְהָ֖ר לָאוֹצָרֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And all Judah brought [the] tithe of the grain and the new wine and the fresh oil to the storehouses.

en.L: And all Judah brought the tithe of the grain and the new wine and the fresh oil into the storehouses.
en.B: Then all Judah brought the tithe of the grain, new wine, and olive oil into the storehouses.
en.R: Then all the people of Judah brought a tenth of their grain, new wine, and olive oil to the storerooms.

es.L: Y todo Judá trajo el diezmo del grano y del vino nuevo y del aceite fresco a los almacenes.
es.B: Entonces todo Judá trajo a los almacenes el diezmo del grano, del vino nuevo y del aceite de oliva.
es.R: Entonces toda la gente de Judá llevó a los almacenes la décima parte de su grano, de su vino nuevo y de su aceite de oliva.

fr.L: Et tout Juda apporta la dîme du blé, et du vin nouveau, et de l’huile fraîche dans les magasins.
fr.B: Alors tout Juda apporta dans les magasins la dîme du blé, du vin nouveau et de l’huile d’olive.
fr.R: Alors tous les gens de Juda ont apporté dans les réserves le dixième de leur blé, de leur vin nouveau et de leur huile d’olive.

sw.L: Na Yuda wote wakaleta fungu la kumi la nafaka na la divai mpya na la mafuta mapya katika ghala.
sw.B: Ndipo Yuda wote walileta fungu la kumi la nafaka, la divai mpya na la mafuta ya zeituni katika ghala.
sw.R: Ndipo watu wote wa Yuda walileta katika ghala sehemu ya kumi ya nafaka yao, divai mpya na mafuta ya zeituni.

vi.L: Và cả Giu-đa đem phần mười của ngũ cốc, rượu mới và dầu mới vào các kho.
vi.B: Bấy giờ cả Giu-đa đem phần mười ngũ cốc, rượu mới và dầu ô-liu vào các kho.
vi.R: Bấy giờ toàn dân Giu-đa đem một phần mười ngũ cốc, rượu mới và dầu ô-liu của mình đến các nhà kho.

ko.L: 그리고 온 유다가 곡식과 새 포도주와 신선한 기름의 십일조를 곳간들로 가져왔다.
ko.B: 그러자 온 유다가 곡식과 새 포도주와 올리브기름의 십일조를 곳간으로 가져왔다.
ko.R: 그러자 유다 백성이 모두 곡식과 새 포도주와 올리브기름의 십분의 일을 창고로 가져왔다.

pt.L: E todo Judá trouxe o dízimo do cereal, e do vinho novo, e do azeite aos depósitos.
pt.B: Então todo Judá trouxe aos depósitos o dízimo do cereal, do vinho novo e do azeite.
pt.R: Então todo o povo de Judá trouxe aos depósitos a décima parte do seu cereal, do seu vinho novo e do seu azeite de oliva.

am.L: ይሁዳም ሁሉ የእህሉን፣ የአዲሱን የወይን ጠጅና የዘይቱን አሥራት ወደ ግምጃ ቤቶቹ አመጡ።
am.B: ከዚያም ይሁዳ ሁሉ የእህሉን፣ የአዲሱን የወይን ጠጅና የወይራ ዘይቱን አሥራት ወደ ግምጃ ቤቶቹ አመጡ።
am.R: ከዚያም የይሁዳ ሕዝብ ሁሉ የእህላቸውን፣ የአዲሱን የወይን ጠጅና የወይራ ዘይታቸውን አንድ አሥረኛ ወደ ዕቃ ቤቶቹ አመጡ።

hi.L: और सारे यहूदा ने अन्न और नए दाखमधु और ताज़े तेल का दशमांश भंडारों में लाया।
hi.B: तब सारे यहूदा ने अन्न, नए दाखमधु और जैतून के तेल का दशमांश भंडारों में ला दिया।
hi.R: तब यहूदा के सब लोग अपने अन्न, नए दाखमधु और जैतून के तेल का दसवाँ भाग भंडार की कोठरियों में ले आए।

ru.L: И весь Иуда принёс десятину зерна, и молодого вина, и свежего масла в хранилища.
ru.B: Тогда весь Иуда принёс в хранилища десятину зерна, молодого вина и оливкового масла.
ru.R: Тогда весь народ Иуды принёс в кладовые десятую часть своего зерна, молодого вина и оливкового масла.

ja.L: そして、全ユダは、穀物と新しいぶどう酒と新しい油の十分の一を倉に運んで来た。
ja.B: すると、ユダの人々はみな、穀物、新しいぶどう酒、オリーブ油の十分の一を倉に納めた。
ja.R: すると、ユダの人々はみな、穀物と新しいぶどう酒とオリーブ油の十分の一を、倉庫に運んで来ました。

decisions.choice: all Judah brought the tithe
decisions.reason: The whole people of the province took up again what they had pledged (10:38-39); the stores that fed the temple servants were filled once more.

decisions.choice: a tenth of their grain
decisions.reason: Readable says what a tithe is.

decisions.choice: 'otsarot "倉" (L, B), "倉庫" (R)
alternatives: "貯蔵室" (B), which is kept for leshakhot
decisions.reason: 'otsarot is a different word from the leshakhot (部屋, 貯蔵室) of 13:4-9; R 倉庫 as for both in chapters 10-12.

source.text: וָאוֹצְרָ֣ה עַל־א֠וֹצָרוֹת שֶׁלֶמְיָ֨ה הַכֹּהֵ֜ן וְצָד֣וֹק הַסּוֹפֵ֗ר וּפְדָיָה֙ מִן־הַלְוִיִּ֔ם וְעַל־יָדָ֔ם חָנָ֥ן בֶּן־זַכּ֖וּר בֶּן־מַתַּנְיָ֑ה כִּ֤י נֶאֱמָנִים֙ נֶחְשָׁ֔בוּ וַעֲלֵיהֶ֖ם לַחֲלֹ֥ק לַאֲחֵיהֶֽם׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And I made treasurers over [the] storehouses Shelemiah the priest and Zadok the scribe and Pedaiah from the Levites, and at their hand Hanan son of Zaccur son of Mattaniah, for reliable they were counted, and on them [was] to distribute to their brothers.

en.L: And I made treasurers over the storehouses Shelemiah the priest and Zadok the scribe and Pedaiah from the Levites, and at their hand Hanan son of Zaccur son of Mattaniah, for they were counted reliable, and on them [it was] to distribute to their brothers.
en.B: And I appointed as treasurers over the storehouses Shelemiah the priest, Zadok the scribe, and Pedaiah of the Levites, and as their assistant Hanan son of Zaccur son of Mattaniah, for they were counted reliable. Their duty was to distribute to their brothers.
en.R: I put three men in charge of the storerooms: Shelemiah the priest, Zadok the scribe, and Pedaiah, a Levite. Hanan son of Zaccur and grandson of Mattaniah was their helper. Everyone knew these men could be trusted. Their job was to hand out the supplies fairly to the other priests and Levites.

es.L: Y puse como tesoreros sobre los almacenes a Selemías el sacerdote, y a Sadoc el escriba, y a Pedaías de los levitas, y junto a ellos a Hanán hijo de Zacur, hijo de Matanías, porque eran tenidos por fieles, y a ellos [les tocaba] repartir a sus hermanos.
