decisions.reason: The word for God's covenant love as in the prayer of 9:17, 9:32; Japanese has no deity-pronoun span, so あなた is used at every level.

source.text: גַּ֣ם׀בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֗ם רָאִ֤יתִי אֶת־הַיְּהוּדִים֙ הֹשִׁ֗יבוּ נָשִׁים֙ אַשְׁדֳּדִיּ֔וֹתעַמֳּנִיּ֖וֹתמוֹאֲבִיּֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: Also in the days, those, I saw the Jews [who] had married women, Ashdodites, Ammonites, Moabites.

en.L: Also in those days I saw the Jews [who] had married women of Ashdod, of Ammon, of Moab.
en.B: In those days I also saw the Jews who had married women of Ashdod, Ammon, and Moab.
en.R: At that time I also saw that some Jewish men had married women from Ashdod, Ammon, and Moab.

es.L: También en aquellos días vi a los judíos [que] se habían casado con mujeres asdoditas, amonitas, moabitas.
es.B: En aquellos días vi también a los judíos que se habían casado con mujeres de Asdod, de Amón y de Moab.
es.R: En aquel tiempo vi también que algunos hombres judíos se habían casado con mujeres de Asdod, de Amón y de Moab.

fr.L: Aussi en ces jours-là je vis les Juifs [qui] avaient épousé des femmes ashdodiennes, ammonites, moabites.
fr.B: En ces jours-là, je vis aussi les Juifs qui avaient épousé des femmes d’Ashdod, d’Ammon et de Moab.
fr.R: À cette époque, j’ai vu aussi que certains Juifs avaient épousé des femmes d’Ashdod, d’Ammon et de Moab.

sw.L: Pia katika siku zile nikawaona Wayahudi [waliokuwa] wameoa wanawake wa Ashdodi, wa Amoni, wa Moabu.
sw.B: Katika siku zile pia niliwaona Wayahudi waliokuwa wameoa wanawake wa Ashdodi, Amoni na Moabu.
sw.R: Wakati huo pia niliona kwamba baadhi ya wanaume wa Kiyahudi walikuwa wameoa wanawake kutoka Ashdodi, Amoni na Moabu.

vi.L: Cũng trong những ngày ấy, tôi thấy những người Do Thái [đã] cưới phụ nữ Ách-đốt, Am-môn, Mô-áp.
vi.B: Cũng trong những ngày ấy, tôi thấy những người Do Thái đã cưới vợ là phụ nữ Ách-đốt, Am-môn và Mô-áp.
vi.R: Vào thời đó, tôi cũng thấy có những người đàn ông Do Thái đã cưới phụ nữ từ Ách-đốt, Am-môn và Mô-áp.

ko.L: 또 그 날들에 나는 아스돗과 암몬과 모압 여자들을 아내로 맞아들인 유대인들을 보았다.
ko.B: 그 무렵 나는 또 아스돗과 암몬과 모압 여자들과 결혼한 유대인들을 보았다.
ko.R: 그 무렵 나는 또 유대 남자들 가운데 몇몇이 아스돗과 암몬과 모압에서 온 여자들과 결혼한 것을 보았다.

pt.L: Também naqueles dias vi os judeus que tinham se casado com mulheres asdoditas, amonitas [e] moabitas.
pt.B: Naqueles dias também vi judeus que tinham se casado com mulheres de Asdode, de Amom e de Moabe.
pt.R: Naquele tempo também vi que alguns homens judeus tinham se casado com mulheres de Asdode, de Amom e de Moabe.

am.L: በዚያም ወራት ደግሞ የአዛጦንን፣ የአሞንንና የሞዓብን ሴቶች ያገቡ አይሁድን አየሁ።
am.B: በዚያ ወራት ደግሞ የአዛጦንን፣ የአሞንንና የሞዓብን ሴቶች ያገቡ አይሁድን አየሁ።
am.R: በዚያን ጊዜ ደግሞ አንዳንድ አይሁዳውያን ወንዶች ከአዛጦን፣ ከአሞንና ከሞዓብ ሴቶችን እንዳገቡ አየሁ።

hi.L: उन दिनों में भी मैंने उन यहूदियों को देखा [जिन्होंने] अशदोदी, अम्मोनी [और] मोआबी स्त्रियों से विवाह किया था।
hi.B: उन दिनों मैंने उन यहूदियों को भी देखा जिन्होंने अशदोद, अम्मोन और मोआब की स्त्रियों से विवाह किया था।
hi.R: उस समय मैंने यह भी देखा कि कुछ यहूदी पुरुषों ने अशदोद, अम्मोन और मोआब की स्त्रियों से विवाह किया था।

ru.L: Также в те дни я увидел иудеев, [которые] взяли жён — азотянок, аммонитянок, моавитянок.
ru.B: В те дни я также увидел иудеев, которые женились на женщинах из Азота, Аммона и Моава.
ru.R: В то время я также увидел, что некоторые иудеи женились на женщинах из Азота, Аммона и Моава.

ja.L: また、そのころ、わたしは、アシュドド人、アンモン人、モアブ人の女たちを妻にしたユダヤ人たちを見た。
ja.B: また、そのころ、わたしは、アシュドド、アンモン、モアブの女たちと結婚したユダヤ人たちを見た。
ja.R: また、そのころ、ユダヤ人の男たちの中に、アシュドドやアンモンやモアブの女の人と結婚した人たちがいるのを見ました。

decisions.choice: Ashdod, Ammon, Moab: neighboring peoples
decisions.reason: Ashdod was one of the old Philistine cities on the coast, by then the center of a Persian province and among Nehemiah's opponents (4:1). Ammon and Moab lay east of the Jordan, the peoples named in the law read in verse 1.

decisions.choice: had married: literally "had caused to dwell"
decisions.reason: The verb means to settle a wife in one's house, a way of saying "to marry" used in Ezra 10:2, 10 for the same situation. The people had pledged not to make such marriages (10:31), as Ezra had dealt with a generation earlier (Ezra 9-10).

decisions.choice: the spelling of Ashdodites and Ammonites
decisions.reason: The written consonants of these two words differ slightly from the way the text is read, as the Masoretes noted in the margin (the qere). This translation follows the reading, as the source data does; the meaning is the same either way.

decisions.choice: some Jewish men
decisions.reason: Readable says "some" because the text does not mean that all the Jews had done this.

decisions.choice: mulheres asdoditas, amonitas [e] moabitas (L); mulheres de Asdode, de Amom e de Moabe (B, R)
decisions.reason: As 4:1 in Portuguese: the gentilic in -ita at Literal, "asdoditas" with "amonitas" and "moabitas" (m1), and the names of the places at Balanced and Readable, as the English says "women of Ashdod".

decisions.choice: "አዛጦን" for Ashdod, as Joshua 15:46 and 1 Samuel 5 on main
decisions.reason: The form on main.

decisions.choice: "иудеи"; "Азот" for Ashdod
decisions.reason: "Иудеи" for the Jews, as in the New Testament; Ashdod keeps the form of Joshua and 1 Samuel in this translation.

decisions.choice: Ashdod "アシュドド"
decisions.reason: As Joshua, Samuel and Chronicles.

source.text: וּבְנֵיהֶ֗ם חֲצִי֙ מְדַבֵּ֣ר אַשְׁדּוֹדִ֔ית וְאֵינָ֥ם מַכִּירִ֖ים לְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוּדִ֑ית וְכִלְשׁ֖וֹן עַ֥ם וָעָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And their children, half [was] speaking Ashdodite, and not they [were] knowing [how] to speak Judean, and according to [the] language of people and people.

en.L: And their children, half spoke Ashdodite, and they did not know [how] to speak Judean, but [spoke] according to the language of people and people.
en.B: Half of their children spoke the language of Ashdod, or the language of one people or another, and they did not know how to speak the language of Judah.
en.R: Half of their children spoke the language of Ashdod or of one of the other peoples. They could not speak the language of Judah.

es.L: Y sus hijos, la mitad hablaba asdodeo, y no sabían hablar judío, sino [que hablaban] según la lengua de pueblo y pueblo.
es.B: La mitad de sus hijos hablaba la lengua de Asdod, o la lengua de uno u otro pueblo, y no sabían hablar la lengua de Judá.
es.R: La mitad de sus hijos hablaba la lengua de Asdod o la de alguno de los otros pueblos. No sabían hablar la lengua de Judá.

fr.L: Et leurs enfants, la moitié parlait l’ashdodien, et ils ne savaient pas parler le judéen, mais [parlaient] selon la langue de peuple et peuple.
fr.B: La moitié de leurs enfants parlaient la langue d’Ashdod, ou la langue de tel ou tel peuple, et ne savaient pas parler la langue de Juda.
fr.R: La moitié de leurs enfants parlaient la langue d’Ashdod ou celle d’un des autres peuples. Ils ne savaient pas parler la langue de Juda.

sw.L: Na watoto wao, nusu walizungumza Kiashdodi, wala hawakujua kuzungumza Kiyahudi, bali [walizungumza] kwa lugha ya watu na watu.
sw.B: Nusu ya watoto wao walizungumza lugha ya Ashdodi, au lugha ya taifa moja au jingine, wala hawakujua kuzungumza lugha ya Yuda.
sw.R: Nusu ya watoto wao walizungumza lugha ya Ashdodi au ya mojawapo ya mataifa mengine. Hawakuweza kuzungumza lugha ya Yuda.

vi.L: Và con cái họ, một nửa nói tiếng Ách-đốt, và không biết nói tiếng Giu-đa, nhưng [nói] theo ngôn ngữ của dân này dân kia.
vi.B: Một nửa số con cái họ nói tiếng Ách-đốt, hoặc tiếng của dân này dân kia, và không biết nói tiếng Giu-đa.
vi.R: Một nửa số con cái họ nói tiếng Ách-đốt hoặc tiếng của một dân khác. Chúng không biết nói tiếng Giu-đa.

ko.L: 그리고 그들의 자녀들은 절반이 아스돗 말을 하고, 유다 말을 할 줄 몰랐으며, 이 백성 저 백성의 언어대로 [말했다].
ko.B: 그들의 자녀들 가운데 절반은 아스돗 말이나 이런저런 백성의 말을 하고, 유다 말은 할 줄 몰랐다.
ko.R: 그들의 자녀들 가운데 절반은 아스돗 말이나 다른 민족의 말을 했다. 그들은 유다 말을 할 줄 몰랐다.

pt.L: E os filhos deles, metade falava [a língua] asdodita, e não sabiam falar [a língua] de Judá, mas [falavam] segundo a língua de cada povo.
pt.B: Metade dos filhos deles falava a língua de Asdode, ou a língua de um ou de outro povo, e não sabiam falar a língua de Judá.
pt.R: Metade dos filhos deles falava a língua de Asdode ou de um dos outros povos. Eles não sabiam falar a língua de Judá.

am.L: ልጆቻቸውም እኩሌቶቹ አዛጦንኛ ይናገሩ ነበር፤ አይሁድኛም መናገር አያውቁም ነበር፤ ነገር ግን እንደ ሕዝብና ሕዝብ ቋንቋ [ይናገሩ ነበር]።
am.B: ከልጆቻቸው እኩሌቶቹ የአዛጦንን ቋንቋ ወይም የአንዱን ወይም የሌላውን ሕዝብ ቋንቋ ይናገሩ ነበር፤ የይሁዳን ቋንቋ መናገር አያውቁም ነበር።
am.R: ከልጆቻቸው እኩሌቶቹ የአዛጦንን ወይም የሌላውን ሕዝብ ቋንቋ ይናገሩ ነበር። የይሁዳን ቋንቋ መናገር አይችሉም ነበር።

hi.L: और उनके बच्चे, आधे अशदोदी बोलते थे, और यहूदी [भाषा] बोलना नहीं जानते थे, पर इस और उस जाति की भाषा के अनुसार [बोलते थे]।
hi.B: उनके आधे बच्चे अशदोद की भाषा, या किसी और जाति की भाषा बोलते थे, और यहूदा की भाषा बोलना नहीं जानते थे।
hi.R: उनके आधे बच्चे अशदोद की या किसी दूसरी जाति की भाषा बोलते थे। वे यहूदा की भाषा नहीं बोल पाते थे।

ru.L: И их дети — половина говорила по-азотски, и они не умели говорить по-иудейски, а [говорили] по языку того или другого народа.
ru.B: Половина их детей говорила на языке Азота или на языке того или иного народа, а говорить на языке Иуды они не умели.
ru.R: Половина их детей говорила на языке Азота или на языке какого-нибудь другого народа. Они не умели говорить на языке Иуды.

ja.L: そして、彼らの子どもたちは、半分がアシュドドの言葉を話し、ユダの言葉を話すことを知らず、それぞれの民の言葉にしたがって[話した]。
ja.B: 彼らの子どもたちの半分は、アシュドドの言葉や、ほかのそれぞれの民の言葉を話し、ユダの言葉を話すことができなかった。
ja.R: その子どもたちの半分は、アシュドドの言葉や、ほかの国の言葉を話していて、ユダの言葉を話すことができませんでした。

decisions.choice: Judean: the Hebrew language
decisions.reason: "Judean" is the language of Judah, Hebrew, as in 2 Kings 18:26, 28 and Isaiah 36:11, 13, where it is set against Aramaic. The children of these marriages grew up unable to understand the language in which the law was read (8:1-8).

decisions.choice: the language of people and people: of one people or another
decisions.reason: The repeated noun means "of each people": the children spoke the language of whatever people their mother came from (compare Esther 1:22).

decisions.choice: Ashdodite: the language of Ashdod
decisions.reason: What language this was is not known; Philistine had probably died out, and it may have been a local dialect of Aramaic or of the coastal Canaanite languages.

decisions.choice: the order of the clauses
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put the two kinds of foreign speech together and end with what the children could not speak; Literal keeps the Hebrew order.

decisions.choice: [a língua] asdodita (L), a língua de Asdode (B, R); [a língua] de Judá (L), a língua de Judá (B, R)
decisions.reason: As 2 Kings 18:26 in Portuguese, the language of Judah is "a língua de Judá" (m1): "judaico" would mean Jewish in a later sense, and "hebraico" names it from outside. The language of Ashdod (m3) is named the same way, with Literal's gentilic as in verse 23.

decisions.choice: "አዛጦንኛ" and "አይሁድኛ" (Literal), with the suffix Amharic uses for names of languages (as "አማርኛ"); "የአዛጦን ቋንቋ", "የይሁዳ ቋንቋ" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names the language "Judean"; the meaning decision says it was Hebrew, but the text does not use that name, so the Amharic does not either.

decisions.choice: "यहूदी [भाषा]" (L); "यहूदा की भाषा" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Judean is the Hebrew spoken in Judah (meaning m1); the Hindi says "the language of Judah", as the English does, rather than naming it "इब्रानी", which the text does not.

decisions.choice: yehudit "ユダの言葉" at every level
decisions.reason: The English keeps 'the language of Judah' at every level, as 2 Kings 18:26 does; ヘブライ語 would name it in a way the text does not.

source.text: וָאָרִ֤יב עִמָּם֙ וָאֲקַֽלְלֵ֔ם וָאַכֶּ֥ה מֵהֶ֛ם אֲנָשִׁ֖ים וָֽאֶמְרְטֵ֑ם וָאַשְׁבִּיעֵ֣ם בֵּֽאלֹהִ֗ים אִם־תִּתְּנ֤וּ בְנֹֽתֵיכֶם֙ לִבְנֵיהֶ֔ם וְאִם־תִּשְׂאוּ֙ מִבְּנֹ֣תֵיהֶ֔ם לִבְנֵיכֶ֖ם וְלָכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And I contended with them and I cursed them and I struck men of them and I pulled out their hair, and I made them swear by God: If you will give your daughters to their sons, and if you will take of their daughters for your sons and for yourselves!

en.L: And I contended with them and cursed them, and I struck men of them and pulled out their hair, and I made them swear by God, "[May God judge you] if you give your daughters to their sons, and if you take of their daughters for your sons and for yourselves!"
en.B: And I contended with them and cursed them, and I struck some of their men and pulled out their hair. And I made them swear by God, "You will not give your daughters to their sons, nor take any of their daughters for your sons or for yourselves."
en.R: I argued with them and called down curses on them. I beat some of the men and pulled out their hair. Then I made them take an oath in God's name: "You will not let your daughters marry their sons, and you will not take their daughters as wives for your sons or for yourselves."

es.L: Y contendí con ellos y los maldije, y golpeé a algunos de sus hombres y les arranqué el cabello, y los hice jurar por Dios: «¡[Que Dios {{plural_you:los|os}} castigue] si {{plural_you:dan|dais}} {{plural_you:sus hijas|vuestras hijas}} a los hijos de ellos, y si {{plural_you:toman|tomáis}} de las hijas de ellos para {{plural_you:sus hijos|vuestros hijos}} y para {{plural_you:ustedes mismos|vosotros mismos}}!».
es.B: Los reprendí y los maldije, golpeé a algunos de sus hombres y les arranqué el cabello. Y los hice jurar por Dios: «No {{plural_you:darán|daréis}} {{plural_you:sus hijas|vuestras hijas}} a los hijos de ellos, ni {{plural_you:tomarán|tomaréis}} ninguna de las hijas de ellos para {{plural_you:sus hijos|vuestros hijos}} ni para {{plural_you:ustedes mismos|vosotros mismos}}».
es.R: Discutí con ellos y pedí que cayeran maldiciones sobre ellos. Golpeé a algunos de los hombres y les arranqué el cabello. Luego les hice jurar en el nombre de Dios: «No {{plural_you:dejarán|dejaréis}} que {{plural_you:sus hijas|vuestras hijas}} se casen con los hijos de ellos, ni {{plural_you:tomarán|tomaréis}} a las hijas de ellos como esposas para {{plural_you:sus hijos|vuestros hijos}} ni para {{plural_you:ustedes mismos|vosotros mismos}}».

fr.L: Et je m’en pris à eux et je les maudis, et je frappai certains de leurs hommes et leur arrachai les cheveux, et je les fis jurer par Dieu : « [Que Dieu vous punisse] si vous donnez vos filles à leurs fils, et si vous prenez de leurs filles pour vos fils et pour vous-mêmes ! »
fr.B: Je m’en pris à eux et je les maudis, je frappai certains de leurs hommes et leur arrachai les cheveux. Et je les fis jurer par Dieu : « Vous ne donnerez pas vos filles à leurs fils, et vous ne prendrez aucune de leurs filles pour vos fils ni pour vous-mêmes. »
fr.R: Je les ai sévèrement réprimandés et j’ai appelé des malédictions sur eux. J’ai frappé certains des hommes et je leur ai arraché les cheveux. Puis je leur ai fait prêter serment au nom de Dieu : « Vous ne laisserez pas vos filles épouser leurs fils, et vous ne prendrez pas leurs filles comme épouses pour vos fils ni pour vous-mêmes. »

sw.L: Nikabishana nao, nikawalaani, nikawapiga baadhi ya wanaume wao, nikawang'oa nywele zao, nikawaapisha kwa Mungu, "[Mungu awaadhibu] mkiwapa wana wao binti zenu, na mkiwatwaa binti zao kwa ajili ya wana wenu na kwa ajili yenu wenyewe!"
sw.B: Basi nilibishana nao, nikawalaani, nikawapiga baadhi ya wanaume wao na kuwang'oa nywele. Nikawaapisha kwa Mungu, "Hamtawaoza binti zenu kwa wana wao, wala hamtawatwaa binti zao kwa ajili ya wana wenu au kwa ajili yenu wenyewe."
sw.R: Nilibishana nao na kuwaombea laana. Niliwapiga baadhi ya wanaume na kuwang'oa nywele. Kisha nikawaapisha kwa jina la Mungu: "Hamtawaruhusu binti zenu kuolewa na wana wao, wala hamtawachukua binti zao kuwa wake wa wana wenu au wake zenu wenyewe."

vi.L: Và tôi trách cứ họ và nguyền rủa họ, và tôi đánh một số người trong họ và nhổ tóc họ, và tôi bắt họ chỉ Đức Chúa Trời mà thề: "[Nguyện Đức Chúa Trời phạt các người] nếu các người gả con gái các người cho con trai các dân ấy, và nếu các người cưới con gái các dân ấy cho con trai các người và cho chính mình!"
vi.B: Tôi trách cứ họ và nguyền rủa họ, đánh một số người trong họ và nhổ tóc họ. Tôi bắt họ chỉ Đức Chúa Trời mà thề: "Các người sẽ không gả con gái mình cho con trai các dân ấy, cũng không cưới con gái các dân ấy cho con trai mình hay cho chính mình."
vi.R: Tôi tranh cãi với họ và cầu cho họ bị rủa sả. Tôi đánh một số người đàn ông trong họ và nhổ tóc họ. Rồi tôi bắt họ nhân danh Đức Chúa Trời mà thề: "Các người sẽ không để con gái mình lấy con trai các dân ấy, và sẽ không cưới con gái các dân ấy làm vợ cho con trai mình hay cho chính mình."

ko.L: 그리고 나는 그들을 꾸짖고 저주했으며, 그들 가운데 몇 사람을 때리고 그들의 머리털을 뽑았다. 그리고 하나님을 두고 그들에게 맹세하게 했다. "너희가 너희 딸들을 그들의 아들들에게 주거나, 그들의 딸들을 너희 아들들이나 너희 자신을 위해 데려오면, [하나님께서 너희를 벌하실 것이다]!"
ko.B: 나는 그들을 꾸짖고 저주했으며, 그들 가운데 몇 사람을 때리고 머리털을 뽑았다. 그리고 하나님을 두고 그들에게 맹세하게 했다. "너희는 너희 딸들을 그들의 아들들에게 주지 않을 것이며, 그들의 딸들을 너희 아들들이나 너희 자신을 위해 데려오지도 않을 것이다."
ko.R: 나는 그들과 따지고, 그들에게 저주가 내리기를 빌었다. 그리고 몇몇 남자들을 때리고 머리털을 뽑았다. 그런 다음 하나님의 이름으로 그들에게 맹세하게 했다. "너희는 너희 딸들을 그들의 아들들과 결혼시키지 않고, 그들의 딸들을 너희 아들들이나 너희 자신의 아내로 맞아들이지도 않겠다."

pt.L: E contendi com eles, e os amaldiçoei, e feri alguns homens deles, e lhes arranquei os cabelos, e os fiz jurar por Deus: "[Que Deus castigue vocês] se derem as suas filhas aos filhos deles, e se tomarem das filhas deles para os seus filhos e para vocês mesmos!"
pt.B: Eu os repreendi e os amaldiçoei, bati em alguns dos homens e lhes arranquei os cabelos. E os fiz jurar por Deus: "Vocês não darão as suas filhas aos filhos deles, nem tomarão nenhuma das filhas deles para os seus filhos ou para vocês mesmos."
pt.R: Discuti com eles e roguei pragas sobre eles. Bati em alguns dos homens e arranquei os cabelos deles. Depois eu os obriguei a jurar em nome de Deus: "Vocês não vão deixar as suas filhas se casarem com os filhos deles, e não vão tomar as filhas deles como esposas para os seus filhos nem para vocês mesmos."

am.L: ከእነርሱም ጋር ተከራከርኩ፤ ረገምኳቸውም፤ ከእነርሱም ሰዎችን መታሁ፤ ጠጉራቸውንም ነጨሁ፤ በእግዚአብሔርም አማልኳቸው፦ «ሴቶች ልጆቻችሁን ለወንዶች ልጆቻቸው ብትሰጡ፣ ከሴቶች ልጆቻቸውም ለወንዶች ልጆቻችሁና ለራሳችሁ ብትወስዱ [እግዚአብሔር ይፍረድባችሁ]!»
am.B: ከእነርሱ ጋር ተከራከርኩ፤ ረገምኳቸውም፤ ከወንዶቻቸውም አንዳንዶቹን መታሁ፤ ጠጉራቸውንም ነጨሁ። በእግዚአብሔርም አማልኳቸው፦ «ሴቶች ልጆቻችሁን ለወንዶች ልጆቻቸው አትድሩም፤ ከሴቶች ልጆቻቸውም ለወንዶች ልጆቻችሁም ሆነ ለራሳችሁ አትወስዱም።»
am.R: ተከራከርኳቸው፤ እርግማንም አወረድኩባቸው። ከወንዶቹ አንዳንዶቹን ደበደብኳቸው፤ ጠጉራቸውንም ነጨሁ። ከዚያም በእግዚአብሔር ስም እንዲምሉ አደረግኋቸው፦ «ሴቶች ልጆቻችሁ ወንዶች ልጆቻቸውን እንዲያገቡ አትፈቅዱም፤ ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውንም ለወንዶች ልጆቻችሁም ሆነ ለራሳችሁ ሚስቶች አድርጋችሁ አትወስዱም።»

hi.L: और मैंने उनसे वाद-विवाद किया और उन्हें शाप दिया, और उनमें से कुछ पुरुषों को मारा और उनके बाल नोचे, और मैंने उन्हें परमेश्वर की शपथ खिलाई, "[परमेश्वर तुम्हारा न्याय करे] यदि तुम अपनी पुत्रियाँ उनके पुत्रों को दो, और यदि तुम उनकी पुत्रियों में से अपने पुत्रों के लिए और अपने लिए लो!"
hi.B: मैंने उन्हें डाँटा और शाप दिया, और उनमें से कुछ पुरुषों को मारा और उनके बाल नोचे। और मैंने उन्हें परमेश्वर की शपथ खिलाई, "तुम अपनी पुत्रियाँ उनके पुत्रों को नहीं दोगे, और न उनकी पुत्रियों में से किसी को अपने पुत्रों के लिए या अपने लिए लोगे।"
hi.R: मैंने उनसे बहस की और उन्हें शाप दिया। मैंने कुछ पुरुषों को पीटा और उनके बाल नोच लिए। फिर मैंने उन्हें परमेश्वर के नाम की शपथ खिलाई: "तुम अपनी बेटियों का विवाह उनके बेटों से नहीं होने दोगे, और न उनकी बेटियों को अपने बेटों के लिए या अपने लिए पत्नी बनाओगे।"

ru.L: И я спорил с ними, и проклинал их, и бил [некоторых] мужчин из них, и рвал у них волосы, и заставил их поклясться Богом: «[Пусть Бог осудит вас], если отдадите ваших дочерей их сыновьям и если возьмёте из их дочерей для ваших сыновей и для себя!»
ru.B: Я упрекал их и проклинал их, бил некоторых из их мужчин и рвал у них волосы. И я заставил их поклясться Богом: «Вы не будете отдавать своих дочерей их сыновьям и не будете брать их дочерей ни для своих сыновей, ни для себя.»
ru.R: Я спорил с ними и призывал на них проклятия. Некоторых мужчин я бил и рвал у них волосы. Потом я заставил их дать клятву именем Бога: «Вы не позволите своим дочерям выходить замуж за их сыновей и не будете брать их дочерей в жёны ни своим сыновьям, ни себе.»

ja.L: そこで、わたしは彼らを責め、彼らを呪い、彼らのうちの何人かの男を打ち、その髪を引き抜いた。そして、わたしは彼らに神にかけて誓わせた。「あなたがたは、自分の娘たちを彼らの息子たちに与えてはならない。また、彼らの娘たちを、自分の息子たちのためにも、自分自身のためにもめとってはならない！」
ja.B: わたしは彼らを責めて、呪い、何人かの男を打ち、その髪を引き抜いた。そして、彼らに神にかけて誓わせた。「あなたがたは自分の娘を彼らの息子に嫁がせず、彼らの娘を自分の息子や自分自身の妻としてめとらない。」
ja.R: わたしは彼らを責めて、のろいの言葉を浴びせました。そして、何人かの男を打ち、その髪の毛を引き抜きました。それから、神の名によって誓わせました。「あなたたちは、自分の娘を彼らの息子と結婚させてはならない。また、彼らの娘を、自分の息子や自分の妻として迎えてはならない。」

decisions.choice: If you give ...: the form of an oath
decisions.reason: A Hebrew oath often names the forbidden act with "if" and leaves the curse unsaid ("may God punish me if ...", compare 1 Samuel 3:17). "If you give" therefore means "you shall not give".

decisions.choice: not giving or taking daughters in marriage
decisions.reason: The words repeat the law (Deuteronomy 7:3) and the people's own pledge (10:31) almost exactly.

decisions.choice: cursed, struck, pulled out hair: public shaming and punishment
decisions.reason: Nehemiah acted as governor with authority to punish (compare Ezra 7:26). Pulling out the hair or beard was a public humiliation (2 Samuel 10:4; Isaiah 50:6). When Ezra faced the same sin, he pulled out his own hair in grief (Ezra 9:3).

decisions.choice: You will not ... (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable turn the Hebrew oath form into a plain promise. Literal keeps the "if" form and supplies the unsaid curse in brackets. Nehemiah's speech goes on into verses 26-27.

decisions.choice: "a los hijos de ellos", "las hijas de ellos"
decisions.reason: With "ustedes" the possessive "sus" would also mean "your"; "de ellos" keeps the foreigners' sons and daughters apart from the men addressed.

decisions.choice: Nehemiah calls the men "các người"; their foreign in-laws are "các dân ấy"
decisions.reason: In a rebuke with blows and an oath, the warm "anh em" used for the people would not fit; "các dân ấy" keeps "their sons" from being read as the hearers' own.

decisions.choice: 해라체 with 너희 at Readable too (verses 25-27)
decisions.reason: The terms note gives 여러분 for Nehemiah speaking to the people at Readable; here he is punishing them and imposing an oath, so Readable keeps the stern 해라체 of Literal and Balanced.

decisions.choice: [Que Deus castigue vocês] se ... (L); Vocês não darão ... nem tomarão (B); Vocês não vão deixar ... e não vão tomar (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew oath names the act with "if" and leaves the curse unsaid (m1). Literal keeps the "if" and supplies the curse in brackets, as the English does; Balanced and Readable turn it into the promise it is, in the words of the pledge of 10:31 and of Deuteronomy 7:3 in Portuguese (m2).

decisions.choice: Literal keeps the oath form "ብትሰጡ ... ብትወስዱ" (if you give ... if you take) with "[እግዚአብሔር ይፍረድባችሁ]" supplied, as the English Literal supplies "[May God judge you]"
alternatives: The negative promise at Literal too
decisions.reason: The Hebrew oath leaves the curse unsaid; the other levels state what was sworn, as the English does. The marriage words echo Deuteronomy 7:3 and Nehemiah 10:31.

decisions.choice: rib "責める" at every level
decisions.reason: As 5:7 and 13:11, 17 (NEH-1 has 責める at R also).

source.text: הֲל֣וֹא עַל־אֵ֣לֶּה חָטָֽא־שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל וּבַגּוֹיִ֣ם הָרַבִּים֩ לֹֽא־הָיָ֨ה מֶ֜לֶךְ כָּמֹ֗הוּ וְאָה֤וּב לֵֽאלֹהָיו֙ הָיָ֔ה וַיִּתְּנֵ֣הוּ אֱלֹהִ֔ים מֶ֖לֶךְ עַל־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל גַּם־אוֹת֣וֹ הֶחֱטִ֔יאוּ הַנָּשִׁ֖ים הַנָּכְרִיּֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: Not on these did sin Solomon king of Israel? And among the nations, the many, not there was a king like him, and loved by his God he was, and made him God king over all Israel; also him caused to sin the women, the foreign.

en.L: "Did not Solomon king of Israel sin on these [things]? And among the many nations there was no king like him, and he was loved by his God, and God made him king over all Israel; even him the foreign women caused to sin.
en.B: "Did not Solomon king of Israel sin on account of such women? Among the many nations there was no king like him, and he was loved by his God, and God made him king over all Israel; yet even he was made to sin by foreign wives.
en.R: "Remember Solomon, king of Israel! Women like these led him into sin. There was no king like him in all the nations. His God loved him and made him king over all Israel. But even Solomon was led into sin by his foreign wives.

es.L: «¿No pecó por estas [cosas] Salomón rey de Israel? Y entre las muchas naciones no hubo rey como él, y era amado por su Dios, y Dios lo puso por rey sobre todo Israel; aun a él lo hicieron pecar las mujeres extranjeras.
es.B: «¿No pecó Salomón rey de Israel a causa de mujeres como estas? Entre las muchas naciones no hubo rey como él; era amado por su Dios, y Dios lo hizo rey sobre todo Israel; y aun a él lo hicieron pecar las esposas extranjeras.
es.R: «¡{{plural_you:Acuérdense|Acordaos}} de Salomón, rey de Israel! Mujeres como estas lo llevaron a pecar. No hubo ningún rey como él en todas las naciones. Su Dios lo amaba y lo hizo rey sobre todo Israel. Pero aun a Salomón lo llevaron a pecar sus esposas extranjeras.

fr.L: « Salomon, roi d’Israël, n’a-t-il pas péché à cause de ces [choses] ? Parmi les nations nombreuses il n’y avait pas de roi comme lui, et il était aimé de son Dieu, et Dieu l’avait fait roi sur tout Israël ; lui aussi, les femmes étrangères l’ont fait pécher.
fr.B: « Salomon, roi d’Israël, n’a-t-il pas péché à cause de femmes comme celles-là ? Parmi les nombreuses nations, il n’y avait pas de roi comme lui ; il était aimé de son Dieu, et Dieu l’avait fait roi sur tout Israël. Et pourtant, lui aussi, ses épouses étrangères l’ont entraîné dans le péché.
fr.R: « Souvenez-vous de Salomon, roi d’Israël ! Des femmes comme celles-là l’ont entraîné dans le péché. Dans toutes les nations, il n’y avait pas de roi comme lui. Son Dieu l’aimait et l’avait fait roi sur tout Israël. Mais même Salomon, ses épouses étrangères l’ont entraîné dans le péché.

sw.L: "Je! Sulemani mfalme wa Israeli hakufanya dhambi kwa mambo [kama] haya? Na katika mataifa mengi hakuwako mfalme kama yeye, naye alipendwa na Mungu wake, na Mungu akamfanya mfalme juu ya Israeli wote; hata yeye wanawake wa kigeni walimkosesha.
sw.B: "Je, Sulemani mfalme wa Israeli hakutenda dhambi kwa sababu ya wanawake kama hawa? Katika mataifa mengi hakuwako mfalme kama yeye; alipendwa na Mungu wake, na Mungu alimfanya mfalme juu ya Israeli wote; lakini hata yeye wake wa kigeni walimfanya atende dhambi.
sw.R: "Mkumbukeni Sulemani, mfalme wa Israeli! Wanawake kama hawa walimwingiza katika dhambi. Hakuwako mfalme kama yeye katika mataifa yote. Mungu wake alimpenda na akamfanya mfalme juu ya Israeli wote. Lakini hata Sulemani aliingizwa katika dhambi na wake zake wa kigeni.

vi.L: "Chẳng phải Sa-lô-môn vua Y-sơ-ra-ên đã phạm tội vì những [việc] này sao? Giữa nhiều dân tộc không có vua nào như ông, và ông được Đức Chúa Trời mình yêu thương, và Đức Chúa Trời lập ông làm vua trên cả Y-sơ-ra-ên; vậy mà chính ông cũng bị các người đàn bà ngoại bang làm cho phạm tội.
vi.B: "Chẳng phải Sa-lô-môn vua Y-sơ-ra-ên đã phạm tội vì những người đàn bà như thế sao? Giữa nhiều dân tộc không có vua nào như ông; ông được Đức Chúa Trời mình yêu thương, và Đức Chúa Trời lập ông làm vua trên cả Y-sơ-ra-ên; thế mà chính ông cũng bị những người vợ ngoại bang khiến cho phạm tội.
vi.R: "Hãy nhớ lại Sa-lô-môn, vua Y-sơ-ra-ên! Những người đàn bà như thế này đã đưa ông vào tội lỗi. Trong mọi dân tộc không có vua nào như ông. Đức Chúa Trời của ông yêu thương ông và lập ông làm vua trên cả Y-sơ-ra-ên. Vậy mà ngay cả Sa-lô-môn cũng bị những người vợ ngoại bang đưa vào tội lỗi.

ko.L: "이스라엘 왕 솔로몬이 이런 [일들] 때문에 죄를 짓지 않았느냐? 많은 나라들 가운데 그와 같은 왕이 없었고, 그는 자기 하나님께 사랑을 받았으며, 하나님께서 그를 온 이스라엘을 다스리는 왕으로 삼으셨다. 그런데 그조차 이방 여인들이 죄를 짓게 했다.
ko.B: "이스라엘 왕 솔로몬도 바로 이런 여인들 때문에 죄를 짓지 않았느냐? 많은 나라들 가운데 그와 같은 왕이 없었고, 그는 자기 하나님께 사랑을 받았으며, 하나님께서 그를 온 이스라엘의 왕으로 세우셨다. 그러나 그조차 이방 아내들 때문에 죄를 짓게 되었다.
ko.R: "이스라엘 왕 솔로몬을 생각해 보아라! 이런 여자들이 그를 죄에 빠뜨렸다. 어느 나라에도 그와 같은 왕은 없었다. 그의 하나님께서 그를 사랑하셔서 온 이스라엘의 왕으로 세우셨다. 그런데 그런 솔로몬도 이방 아내들 때문에 죄에 빠졌다.

pt.L: "Não pecou por causa destas [coisas] Salomão, rei de Israel? E entre as muitas nações não havia rei como ele, e ele era amado pelo seu Deus, e Deus o fez rei sobre todo o Israel; até a ele as mulheres estrangeiras fizeram pecar.
pt.B: "Não foi por causa delas que Salomão, rei de Israel, pecou? Entre as muitas nações não houve rei como ele; ele era amado pelo seu Deus, e Deus o fez rei sobre todo o Israel. Mesmo assim, até ele foi levado a pecar pelas mulheres estrangeiras.
pt.R: "Lembrem-se de Salomão, rei de Israel! Ele pecou por causa de mulheres como essas. Não houve nenhum rei como ele em todas as nações. O seu Deus o amava e o fez rei sobre todo o Israel. Mas até Salomão foi levado a pecar pelas suas mulheres estrangeiras.

am.L: «የእስራኤል ንጉሥ ሰሎሞን በእነዚህ ኃጢአት አልሠራምን? በብዙ ሕዝቦችም መካከል እንደ እርሱ ያለ ንጉሥ አልነበረም፤ በአምላኩም የተወደደ ነበረ፤ እግዚአብሔርም በእስራኤል ሁሉ ላይ ንጉሥ አደረገው፤ እርሱንም እንኳ ባዕዳን ሴቶች ኃጢአት አሠሩት።
am.B: «የእስራኤል ንጉሥ ሰሎሞን በእንደነዚህ ያሉት ሴቶች ምክንያት ኃጢአት አልሠራምን? በብዙ ሕዝቦች መካከል እንደ እርሱ ያለ ንጉሥ አልነበረም፤ በአምላኩ የተወደደ ነበረ፤ እግዚአብሔርም በእስራኤል ሁሉ ላይ ንጉሥ አደረገው። ነገር ግን እርሱን እንኳ ባዕዳን ሚስቶቹ ኃጢአት አሠሩት።
am.R: «የእስራኤልን ንጉሥ ሰሎሞንን አስታውሱ! እንደነዚህ ያሉ ሴቶች ወደ ኃጢአት መሩት። በሕዝቦች ሁሉ መካከል እንደ እርሱ ያለ ንጉሥ አልነበረም። አምላኩ ወደደው፤ በእስራኤልም ሁሉ ላይ ንጉሥ አደረገው። ነገር ግን ሰሎሞን እንኳ በባዕዳን ሚስቶቹ ምክንያት ወደ ኃጢአት ተመራ።

hi.L: "क्या इन्हीं [बातों] में इस्राएल के राजा सुलैमान ने पाप नहीं किया? और बहुत सी जातियों में उसके समान कोई राजा न था, और वह अपने परमेश्वर का प्रिय था, और परमेश्वर ने उसे सारे इस्राएल पर राजा बनाया; उसको भी विदेशी स्त्रियों ने पाप में फँसाया।
hi.B: "क्या इस्राएल के राजा सुलैमान ने ऐसी ही स्त्रियों के कारण पाप नहीं किया? बहुत सी जातियों में उसके समान कोई राजा न था, और वह अपने परमेश्वर का प्रिय था, और परमेश्वर ने उसे सारे इस्राएल पर राजा बनाया; फिर भी विदेशी पत्नियों ने उससे भी पाप करवाया।
hi.R: "इस्राएल के राजा सुलैमान को याद करो! ऐसी ही स्त्रियों ने उसे पाप में फँसाया। सब जातियों में उसके समान कोई राजा न था। उसके परमेश्वर उससे प्रेम करते थे, और उन्होंने उसे सारे इस्राएल पर राजा बनाया। फिर भी सुलैमान को उसकी विदेशी पत्नियों ने पाप में फँसा दिया।

ru.L: «Не из-за этих ли согрешил Соломон, царь Израиля? И среди многих народов не было царя, подобного ему, и он был любим своим Богом, и Бог сделал его царём над всем Израилем; даже его ввели в грех чужеземные женщины.
ru.B: «Разве не из-за таких женщин согрешил Соломон, царь Израиля? Среди многих народов не было царя, подобного ему, он был любим своим Богом, и Бог сделал его царём над всем Израилем; и всё же даже его чужеземные жёны ввели в грех.
ru.R: «Вспомните Соломона, царя Израиля! Такие женщины ввели его в грех. Ни у одного народа не было такого царя, как он. Его Бог любил его и сделал его царём над всем Израилем. Но даже Соломона его чужеземные жёны ввели в грех.

ja.L: 「イスラエルの王ソロモンは、これらのことで罪を犯したではないか。多くの国々の中に彼のような王はなく、彼は自分の神に愛され、神は彼を全イスラエルの上に王とされた。その彼でさえ、外国の女たちが罪を犯させたのだ。
ja.B: 「イスラエルの王ソロモンが罪を犯したのも、このような女たちのためではなかったか。多くの国々の中にも彼のような王はなく、彼は自分の神に愛され、神は彼を全イスラエルの王とされた。その彼でさえ、外国の妻たちによって罪に陥ったのだ。
ja.R: 「イスラエルの王ソロモンのことを思い出しなさい。このような女の人たちのために、ソロモンは罪を犯したのだ。どの国にも、ソロモンほどの王はいなかった。神はソロモンを愛し、全イスラエルの王とされた。そのソロモンでさえ、外国人の妻たちのために、罪を犯すようになったのだ。

decisions.choice: Solomon and his foreign wives
decisions.reason: Solomon married many foreign women, Moabite, Ammonite and others, and in his old age they turned his heart to their gods (1 Kings 11:1-8). The law had warned that such marriages would lead Israel's sons to other gods (Deuteronomy 7:3-4).

decisions.choice: no king like him; loved by his God
decisions.reason: God promised Solomon wisdom and riches beyond any other king (1 Kings 3:12-13). At his birth the LORD loved him, and he was named Jedidiah, "loved by the LORD" (2 Samuel 12:24-25).

decisions.choice: on these: on account of such things
decisions.reason: "These" can mean these women or these deeds, marriages like these; the sense is the same.

decisions.choice: Remember Solomon ...!
decisions.reason: Readable turns the rhetorical question into a statement so the point is plain.

decisions.choice: foreign wives
decisions.reason: The project's wording for these foreign women in Ezra and Nehemiah; Literal keeps "women".

decisions.choice: pecou por causa delas (B), de mulheres como essas (R); as mulheres estrangeiras (every level)
decisions.reason: The verse recalls 1 Kings 11:1-8 (m1), whose Portuguese says "mulheres estrangeiras", so every level keeps those words; Portuguese "mulher" also means wife, so it says what the English "foreign wives" says. Literal keeps the open "destas [coisas]" of the Hebrew (m3); Balanced and Readable say that the women were the cause, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "ባዕዳን ሴቶች" (Literal), "ባዕዳን ሚስቶች" (Balanced, Readable), as Ezra 10 on main and the terms list
decisions.reason: The same matter in Ezra 9-10 keeps one wording; also verse 27.

decisions.choice: "чужеземные женщины" (L); "чужеземные жёны" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verse recalls 1 Kings 11:1-3, whose "чужеземные женщины" Literal keeps; Balanced and Readable say "жёны", as the English says "wives".

decisions.choice: nashim nokhriyyot "外国の女たち" (L), "外国の妻たち" (B), "外国人の妻たち" (R)
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 11:1-8 (外国の女たち) and Ezra 10.

source.text: וְלָכֶ֣ם הֲנִשְׁמַ֗ע לַעֲשֹׂת֙ אֵ֣ת כָּל־הָרָעָ֤ה הַגְּדוֹלָה֙ הַזֹּ֔את לִמְעֹ֖ל בֵּֽאלֹהֵ֑ינוּ לְהֹשִׁ֖יב נָשִׁ֥ים נָכְרִיּֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And to you shall we listen to do all the evil, the great, the this, to act unfaithfully against our God by marrying women, foreign?

en.L: And shall we listen to you, to do all this great evil, to act unfaithfully against our God by marrying foreign women?"
en.B: Shall we then listen to you and do all this great evil, acting unfaithfully against our God by marrying foreign wives?"
en.R: Should we just let you go on doing this terrible evil? You are being unfaithful to our God by marrying foreign wives!"

es.L: ¿Y {{plural_you:a ustedes los escucharemos|a vosotros os escucharemos}}, para hacer todo este gran mal, para ser infieles a nuestro Dios tomando mujeres extranjeras?».
es.B: ¿Vamos entonces a {{plural_you:hacerles caso a ustedes|haceros caso a vosotros}} y a cometer todo este gran mal, siendo infieles a nuestro Dios al tomar esposas extranjeras?».
es.R: ¿Acaso {{plural_you:los|os}} vamos a dejar seguir haciendo esta maldad tan terrible? ¡{{plural_you:Están siendo infieles a nuestro Dios al casarse|Estáis siendo infieles a nuestro Dios al casaros}} con esposas extranjeras!».

fr.L: Et vous écouterons-nous, pour faire tout ce grand mal, pour être infidèles à notre Dieu en épousant des femmes étrangères ? »
fr.B: Allons-nous donc vous écouter et commettre tout ce grand mal, en étant infidèles à notre Dieu par des mariages avec des femmes étrangères ? »
fr.R: Allons-nous vous laisser continuer à faire un mal aussi terrible ? Vous êtes infidèles à notre Dieu en épousant des femmes étrangères ! »

sw.L: Na je, tuwasikilize ninyi, kufanya uovu huu wote mkubwa, kukosa uaminifu kwa Mungu wetu kwa kuoa wanawake wa kigeni?"
sw.B: Je, basi tuwasikilize ninyi na kutenda uovu huu wote mkubwa, tukikosa uaminifu kwa Mungu wetu kwa kuoa wake wa kigeni?"
sw.R: Je, tuwaache tu mwendelee kutenda uovu huu mbaya kabisa? Mnakosa uaminifu kwa Mungu wetu kwa kuoa wake wa kigeni!"

vi.L: Và chúng tôi có nên nghe các người, mà làm mọi điều ác lớn này, mà bất trung với Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta bằng cách cưới những người đàn bà ngoại bang sao?"
vi.B: Lẽ nào chúng tôi lại nghe theo các người mà làm điều ác lớn này, bất trung với Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta bằng cách cưới vợ ngoại bang sao?"
vi.R: Lẽ nào chúng tôi cứ để các người tiếp tục làm điều ác tồi tệ này sao? Các người đang bất trung với Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta khi cưới vợ ngoại bang!"

ko.L: 그러니 우리가 너희 말을 듣고, 이방 여인들을 아내로 맞아 우리 하나님을 배신하는 이 모든 큰 악을 행해야 하겠느냐?"
ko.B: 그런데도 우리가 너희 말을 듣고, 이방 아내들을 맞아들여 우리 하나님을 배신하는 이 큰 악을 저질러야 하겠느냐?"
ko.R: 너희가 이처럼 끔찍한 악을 계속 저지르도록 우리가 그냥 두어야 하겠느냐? 너희는 이방 아내들을 맞아들여 우리 하나님을 배신하고 있다!"

pt.L: E a vocês daremos ouvidos, para fazer todo este grande mal, para agir com infidelidade contra o nosso Deus, casando-se com mulheres estrangeiras?"
pt.B: Será que agora vamos dar ouvidos a vocês e fazer todo esse grande mal, sendo infiéis ao nosso Deus ao se casarem com mulheres estrangeiras?"
pt.R: Será que vamos deixar vocês continuarem fazendo esse mal terrível? Vocês estão sendo infiéis ao nosso Deus ao se casarem com mulheres estrangeiras!"

am.L: እኛስ ባዕዳን ሴቶችን በማግባት በአምላካችን ላይ ክሕደት እንድናደርግ፣ ይህን ታላቅ ክፉ ነገር ሁሉ እናደርግ ዘንድ እናንተን እንሰማለን?»
am.B: ታዲያ እኛ እናንተን ሰምተን ባዕዳን ሚስቶችን በማግባት በአምላካችን ላይ ክሕደት በማድረግ ይህን ታላቅ ክፋት ሁሉ እንፈጽማለን?»
am.R: እናንተ ይህን አስከፊ ክፋት እንድትቀጥሉ ዝም ብለን እንተዋችኋለን? ባዕዳን ሚስቶችን በማግባታችሁ ለአምላካችን ታማኝ አልሆናችሁም!»

hi.L: और क्या हम तुम्हारी सुनें कि यह सारी बड़ी बुराई करें, कि विदेशी स्त्रियों से विवाह करके अपने परमेश्वर से विश्वासघात करें?"
hi.B: तो क्या हम तुम्हारी सुनें और यह सारी बड़ी बुराई करें, और विदेशी पत्नियाँ ब्याहकर अपने परमेश्वर से विश्वासघात करें?"
hi.R: क्या हम तुम्हें यह भयानक बुराई करते रहने दें? विदेशी पत्नियों से विवाह करके तुम हमारे परमेश्वर से विश्वासघात कर रहे हो!"

ru.L: И вас ли нам слушать, чтобы делать всё это великое зло, изменять нашему Богу, беря чужеземных жён?»
ru.B: Неужели нам слушать вас и делать всё это великое зло — изменять нашему Богу, женясь на чужеземках?»
ru.R: Неужели мы позволим вам и дальше творить такое страшное зло? Вы изменяете нашему Богу, женясь на чужеземках!»

ja.L: それなのに、わたしたちは、あなたがたに聞き従って、このすべての大きな悪を行い、外国の女たちをめとって、わたしたちの神に対して背信の罪を犯すべきだろうか。」
ja.B: それなのに、わたしたちは、あなたがたの言うことを聞いて、このような大きな悪を行い、外国の女たちをめとって、わたしたちの神に背信の罪を犯してよいのだろうか。」
ja.R: それなのに、あなたたちがこのようなひどい悪を行うのを、わたしたちが黙って見ていてよいだろうか。あなたたちは外国人の女の人と結婚して、わたしたちの神に対して忠実でないことをしているのだ！」

decisions.choice: shall we listen to you: two possible readings
alternatives: Must we hear about you doing all this great evil?
decisions.reason: The Hebrew can mean "shall we then listen to you (and do the same)?" or "must it be heard of you that you do this?" Either way Nehemiah refuses to accept such marriages.

decisions.choice: act unfaithfully: break faith with God
decisions.reason: The verb means to break faith, to betray a trust; it is the word Ezra used for the same marriages (Ezra 9:2, 4; 10:2, 10).

decisions.choice: Should we just let you go on ...?
decisions.reason: Readable follows the sense common to both readings, that Nehemiah will not let it pass.

decisions.choice: agir com infidelidade (L); sendo infiéis (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb is the one Ezra used for the same marriages (m2), and Nehemiah 1:8 has it in Portuguese: "agir com infidelidade" at Literal, "ser infiel" at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: "ክሕደት አደረገ" (Literal, Balanced), "ታማኝ አልሆነም" (Readable) for acting unfaithfully (maʿal), as Ezra 10:2, 10 on main
decisions.reason: Nehemiah's charge repeats Ezra's in the same matter; one wording for both.

decisions.choice: ma'al "背信の罪を犯す" (L, B), "忠実でないことをする" (R)
decisions.reason: As Ezra 9-10 for the same offence.

source.text: וּמִבְּנֵ֨י יוֹיָדָ֤ע בֶּן־אֶלְיָשִׁיב֙ הַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַגָּד֔וֹל חָתָ֖ן לְסַנְבַלַּ֣ט הַחֹרֹנִ֑י וָאַבְרִיחֵ֖הוּ מֵעָלָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And [one] of [the] sons of Joiada son of Eliashib the priest, the great, [was] son-in-law to Sanballat the Horonite; and I drove him away from me.

en.L: And one of the sons of Joiada son of Eliashib the great priest [was] son-in-law to Sanballat the Horonite; and I drove him away from me.
en.B: And one of the sons of Joiada son of Eliashib the high priest was son-in-law to Sanballat the Horonite; so I drove him away from me.
en.R: One of the grandsons of Eliashib the high priest, a son of Joiada, had married the daughter of Sanballat from Beth-horon. So I chased him away from me.

es.L: Y uno de los hijos de Joiada hijo de Eliasib, el gran sacerdote, [era] yerno de Sanbalat el horonita; y lo eché de mi lado.
es.B: Uno de los hijos de Joiada hijo de Eliasib, el sumo sacerdote, era yerno de Sanbalat el horonita; por eso lo eché de mi lado.
es.R: Uno de los nietos del sumo sacerdote Eliasib, hijo de Joiada, se había casado con la hija de Sanbalat, el de Bet-horón. Por eso lo expulsé de mi presencia.

fr.L: Et l’un des fils de Yoyada, fils d’Éliashib le grand prêtre, [était] gendre de Sanballat le Horonite ; et je le chassai loin de moi.
fr.B: L’un des fils de Yoyada, fils du grand prêtre Éliashib, était le gendre de Sanballat le Horonite ; je le chassai donc loin de moi.
fr.R: L’un des petits-fils du grand prêtre Éliashib, un fils de Yoyada, avait épousé la fille de Sanballat, originaire de Beth-Horôn. Je l’ai donc chassé loin de moi.

sw.L: Na mmoja wa wana wa Yoyada mwana wa Eliashibu kuhani mkuu [alikuwa] mkwe wa Sanbalati Mhoroni; nikamfukuza kutoka kwangu.
sw.B: Mmoja wa wana wa Yoyada mwana wa Eliashibu kuhani mkuu alikuwa mkwe wa Sanbalati Mhoroni; kwa hiyo nilimfukuza kutoka kwangu.
sw.R: Mmoja wa wajukuu wa Eliashibu kuhani mkuu, mwana wa Yoyada, alikuwa amemwoa binti wa Sanbalati wa Beth-horoni. Kwa hiyo nilimfukuza mbali nami.

vi.L: Và một trong các con trai của Giô-gia-đa con trai Ê-li-a-síp, thầy tế lễ lớn, [là] con rể của San-ba-lát người Hô-rôn; và tôi đuổi người ấy khỏi tôi.
vi.B: Một trong các con trai của Giô-gia-đa con trai thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm Ê-li-a-síp là con rể của San-ba-lát người Hô-rôn; vì vậy tôi đuổi người ấy khỏi tôi.
vi.R: Một người cháu nội của thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm Ê-li-a-síp, là con trai của Giô-gia-đa, đã cưới con gái của San-ba-lát, người Bết-Hô-rôn. Vì vậy tôi đuổi người ấy đi khỏi tôi.

ko.L: 그리고 대제사장 엘리아십의 아들 요야다의 아들들 가운데 하나가 호론 사람 산발랏의 사위[였다]. 그래서 나는 그를 내게서 쫓아냈다.
ko.B: 대제사장 엘리아십의 아들 요야다의 아들들 가운데 하나가 호론 사람 산발랏의 사위였다. 그래서 나는 그를 내게서 쫓아냈다.
ko.R: 대제사장 엘리아십의 손자로서 요야다의 아들인 한 사람이 벧호론 출신 산발랏의 딸과 결혼했다. 그래서 나는 그를 내 곁에서 쫓아 버렸다.

pt.L: E um dos filhos de Joiada, filho de Eliasibe, o sumo sacerdote, [era] genro de Sambalate, o horonita; e eu o afugentei de mim.
pt.B: Um dos filhos de Joiada, filho de Eliasibe, o sumo sacerdote, era genro de Sambalate, o horonita; por isso eu o expulsei da minha presença.
pt.R: Um dos netos de Eliasibe, o sumo sacerdote, filho de Joiada, tinha se casado com a filha de Sambalate, de Bete-Horom. Por isso eu o expulsei de perto de mim.

am.L: ከታላቁ ካህን ከኤልያሴብ ልጅ ከዮያዳ ልጆች አንዱ የሖሮናዊው የሰንባላጥ አማች [ነበረ]፤ ከእኔም አሳደድኩት።
am.B: ከሊቀ ካህናቱ ከኤልያሴብ ልጅ ከዮያዳ ልጆች አንዱ የሖሮናዊው የሰንባላጥ አማች ነበረ፤ ስለዚህ ከእኔ አባረርኩት።
am.R: ከሊቀ ካህናቱ ከኤልያሴብ የልጅ ልጆች አንዱ፣ የዮያዳ ልጅ፣ ከቤትሖሮን የሆነውን የሰንባላጥን ልጅ አግብቶ ነበር። ስለዚህ ከእኔ አባረርኩት።

hi.L: और महायाजक एल्याशीब के पुत्र योयादा के पुत्रों में से एक होरोनी सम्बल्लत का दामाद [था]; इसलिए मैंने उसे अपने पास से भगा दिया।
hi.B: महायाजक एल्याशीब के पुत्र योयादा के पुत्रों में से एक होरोनी सम्बल्लत का दामाद था; इसलिए मैंने उसे अपने पास से भगा दिया।
hi.R: महायाजक एल्याशीब के एक पोते ने, जो योयादा का पुत्र था, होरोन के सम्बल्लत की बेटी से विवाह कर लिया था। इसलिए मैंने उसे अपने पास से भगा दिया।

ru.L: И [один] из сыновей Иояды, сына Елиашива, великого священника, [был] зятем Санаваллата хоронитянина; и я прогнал его от себя.
ru.B: Один из сыновей Иояды, сына первосвященника Елиашива, был зятем Санаваллата хоронитянина, и я прогнал его от себя.
ru.R: Один из внуков первосвященника Елиашива, сын Иояды, женился на дочери Санаваллата из Хорона. Поэтому я прогнал его от себя.

ja.L: そして、大祭司エルヤシブの子ヨヤダの子らの一人は、ホロニ人サンバラトの婿であった。それで、わたしは彼をわたしのもとから追い払った。
ja.B: 大祭司エルヤシブの子ヨヤダの息子の一人が、ホロニ人サンバラトの婿になっていた。そこで、わたしは彼を自分のもとから追い出した。
ja.R: 大祭司エルヤシブの孫で、ヨヤダの息子である一人の男が、ホロン出身のサンバラトの娘と結婚していました。そこで、わたしはその男を追い出しました。

decisions.choice: Sanballat the Horonite
decisions.reason: Sanballat was the leader of the opposition to the rebuilding of the wall (2:10, 19; 3:33; 6:1-14). A letter from Elephantine in Egypt (407 BC) names Sanballat as governor of Samaria. "Horonite" probably means he came from Beth-horon, northwest of Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: a priest's family married to the enemy
decisions.reason: The high priest had to marry a woman of his own people (Leviticus 21:14), and the priests were to keep their line pure. A grandson of the high priest, perhaps in line to be high priest himself, had married the daughter of Israel's chief opponent.

decisions.choice: the high priest: Eliashib
decisions.reason: "The high priest" probably describes Eliashib (3:1), though Joiada, his son, may have succeeded him by this time (12:10, 22).

decisions.choice: drove him away from me: expelled him
decisions.reason: Nehemiah drove him out of his presence, and so out of the priestly service in Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: had married the daughter of; from Beth-horon
decisions.reason: Readable explains "son-in-law" and "Horonite".

decisions.choice: o sumo sacerdote (every level); Sambalate, o horonita (L, B), de Bete-Horom (R)
decisions.reason: "Sumo sacerdote" at every level, as 3:1 sets it in Portuguese for the same title (m3); Sanballat keeps the words of 2:10, and Readable names his town, as the English does (m1).

decisions.choice: "ሰንባላጥ" as the terms list; "ሖሮናዊው" (Literal, Balanced) for the Horonite, "ከቤትሖሮን" (Readable), with "ቤትሖሮን" as on main
decisions.reason: The Readable says where he came from, as the English does. "ታላቁ ካህን" (Literal) for "the great priest", "ሊቀ ካህናቱ" (Balanced, Readable).

decisions.choice: "होरोनी सम्बल्लत" (L, B); "होरोन का सम्बल्लत" (R)
decisions.reason: Sanballat keeps the established spelling "सम्बल्लत" as a name, with the nasal consonant, through Nehemiah; Readable explains "the Horonite" as a man from Horon, in the words of 2:10 and 2:19, where the English Readable says "from Beth-horon". Literal says "the great priest" as "महायाजक", the usual Hindi for high priest.

decisions.choice: hakkohen haggadol "大祭司" at every level
decisions.reason: As NEH-1 (3:1); the L English 'great priest' is the same title.

decisions.choice: "ホロニ人サンバラト" (L, B), "ホロン出身のサンバラト" (R)

source.text: זָכְרָ֥ה לָהֶ֖ם אֱלֹהָ֑י עַ֚ל גָּאֳלֵ֣י הַכְּהֻנָּ֔ה וּבְרִ֥ית הַכְּהֻנָּ֖ה וְהַלְוִיִּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Remember for them, my God, on [the] defilements of the priesthood and the covenant of the priesthood and the Levites.

en.L: Remember for them, my God, on [account of] the defilements of the priesthood and the covenant of the priesthood and the Levites.
en.B: Remember them, my God, because they have defiled the priesthood and the covenant of the priesthood and of the Levites.
en.R: My God, remember what these people have done. They have made the priesthood unclean, and they have broken the covenant {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} made with the priests and the Levites.

es.L: Acuérdate de ellos, Dios mío, por las profanaciones del sacerdocio y del pacto del sacerdocio y de los levitas.
es.B: Acuérdate de ellos, Dios mío, porque han profanado el sacerdocio y el pacto del sacerdocio y de los levitas.
es.R: Dios mío, acuérdate de lo que ha hecho esta gente. Han hecho impuro el sacerdocio y han quebrantado el pacto que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} hiciste con los sacerdotes y los levitas.

fr.L: Souviens-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} d’eux, mon Dieu, à cause des souillures du sacerdoce et de l’alliance du sacerdoce et des Lévites.
fr.B: Souviens-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} d’eux, mon Dieu, car ils ont souillé le sacerdoce et l’alliance du sacerdoce et des Lévites.
fr.R: Mon Dieu, souviens-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} de ce que ces gens ont fait. Ils ont rendu impur le sacerdoce, et ils ont rompu l’alliance que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as faite avec les prêtres et les Lévites.

sw.L: Uwakumbuke, Ee Mungu wangu, kwa ajili ya unajisi wa ukuhani na agano la ukuhani na la Walawi.
sw.B: Ee Mungu wangu, uwakumbuke, kwa sababu wameunajisi ukuhani na agano la ukuhani na la Walawi.
sw.R: Ee Mungu wangu, ukumbuke mambo ambayo watu hawa wamefanya. Wameufanya ukuhani kuwa najisi, na wamelivunja agano ambalo {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ulifanya na makuhani na Walawi.

vi.L: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời của con, xin nhớ đến họ, vì những sự ô uế của chức tế lễ và giao ước của chức tế lễ và của người Lê-vi.
vi.B: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời của con, xin nhớ đến họ, vì họ đã làm ô uế chức tế lễ và giao ước của chức tế lễ và của người Lê-vi.
vi.R: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời của con, xin nhớ đến những gì những người này đã làm. Họ đã làm cho chức tế lễ bị ô uế, và đã vi phạm giao ước {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã lập với các thầy tế lễ và người Lê-vi.

ko.L: 제 하나님, 제사장 직분을 더럽힌 일과 제사장 직분과 레위 사람들의 언약을 [더럽힌 일] 때문에 그들을 기억하십시오.
ko.B: 제 하나님, 그들을 기억하십시오. 그들이 제사장 직분을 더럽히고, 제사장 직분과 레위 사람들의 언약을 더럽혔습니다.
ko.R: 제 하나님, 이 사람들이 한 일을 기억하십시오. 그들은 제사장 직분을 더럽혔고, 주님께서 제사장들과 레위 사람들과 맺으신 언약을 깨뜨렸습니다.

pt.L: Lembra-{{deity_pronoun:te|Te}}, ó meu Deus, deles, por causa das contaminações do sacerdócio e da aliança do sacerdócio e dos levitas.
pt.B: Lembra-{{deity_pronoun:te|Te}}, ó meu Deus, deles, porque contaminaram o sacerdócio e a aliança do sacerdócio e dos levitas.
pt.R: Ó meu Deus, lembra-{{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} do que essas pessoas fizeram. Elas tornaram impuro o sacerdócio e quebraram a aliança que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fizeste com os sacerdotes e os levitas.

am.L: አምላኬ ሆይ፣ ስለ ክህነቱ መርከስ፣ ስለ ክህነቱና ስለ ሌዋውያኑም ቃል ኪዳን አስብባቸው።
am.B: አምላኬ ሆይ፣ ክህነቱንና የክህነቱንና የሌዋውያኑን ቃል ኪዳን አርክሰዋልና አስብባቸው።
am.R: አምላኬ ሆይ፣ እነዚህ ሰዎች ያደረጉትን አስብ። ክህነቱን አርክሰዋል፤ ከካህናቱና ከሌዋውያኑ ጋር ያደረግኸውንም ቃል ኪዳን አፍርሰዋል።

hi.L: हे मेरे परमेश्वर, उनके लिए स्मरण कर, याजकपद की अशुद्धताओं के [कारण], और याजकपद और लेवियों की वाचा के [कारण]।
hi.B: हे मेरे परमेश्वर, उन्हें स्मरण कर, क्योंकि उन्होंने याजकपद को और याजकपद और लेवियों की वाचा को अशुद्ध किया है।
hi.R: हे मेरे परमेश्वर, याद रख कि इन लोगों ने क्या किया है। उन्होंने याजकपद को अशुद्ध किया है, और उस वाचा को तोड़ा है जो तूने याजकों और लेवियों के साथ बाँधी थी।

ru.L: Вспомни им, Боже мой, осквернение священства и завета священства и левитов.
ru.B: Вспомни их, Боже мой, за то, что они осквернили священство и завет священства и левитов.
ru.R: Боже мой, вспомни, что сделали эти люди. Они осквернили священство и нарушили завет, который {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} заключил со священниками и левитами.

ja.L: わたしの神よ、祭司職の汚れと、祭司職とレビ人の契約のゆえに、彼らのことを覚えてください。
ja.B: わたしの神よ、彼らのことを覚えていてください。彼らは、祭司職を汚し、祭司職とレビ人との契約を汚したのです。
ja.R: わたしの神よ、この人たちがしたことを覚えていてください。彼らは祭司の務めを汚し、あなたが祭司やレビ人と結ばれた契約を破りました。

decisions.choice: the covenant of the priesthood and the Levites
decisions.reason: God's covenant with Levi and with Phinehas gave the priests their office and asked them to be faithful (Numbers 25:12-13; Malachi 2:4-8). Malachi, in the same period, also charges the priests with corrupting the covenant of Levi.

decisions.choice: Remember them: remember against them
decisions.reason: This is Nehemiah's prayer for judgment, the reverse of his prayer for himself (verses 14, 22, 31), as in 6:14.

decisions.choice: defilements: what made the priesthood unclean
decisions.reason: The word means defilement or pollution (compare Ezra 2:62, where unproven priests were kept out "as unclean"). Marriages like the one in verse 28 defiled the priestly line.

decisions.choice: the covenant you made
decisions.reason: Readable says whose covenant it was.

decisions.choice: Lembra-te, ó meu Deus, deles (L, B); Ó meu Deus, lembra-te do que essas pessoas fizeram (R); contaminações (L), contaminaram (B), tornaram impuro (R)
decisions.reason: The prayer against his opponents (m2) keeps the opening words of 6:14 in Portuguese at each level, "Lembra-te, ó meu Deus, de ..." and "Ó meu Deus, lembra-te de ...". The word for defilement (m3) is "contaminar", the making unclean of what is holy, and Readable says "impuro", the Old Testament terms' word.

decisions.choice: "አስብባቸው" (remember against them), with the suffix "-ባቸው", where the refrain for himself says "አስብልኝ" / "አስበኝ"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads "remember them" as remembering against them; the Amharic suffix says so without added words.

decisions.choice: go'olei "汚れ" (L), "汚した" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Remember-against prayers use the same 覚えてください / 覚えていてください as 6:14.

source.text: וְטִֽהַרְתִּ֖ים מִכָּל־נֵכָ֑ר וָאַעֲמִ֧ידָה מִשְׁמָר֛וֹת לַכֹּהֲנִ֥ים וְלַלְוִיִּ֖ם אִ֥ישׁ בִּמְלַאכְתּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And I purified them from all foreignness, and I established duties for the priests and for the Levites, each in his work,

en.L: And I purified them from everything foreign, and I established duties for the priests and for the Levites, each in his work,
en.B: So I purified them of everything foreign, and I set out the duties of the priests and the Levites, each in his own task,
en.R: So I made the priests and Levites clean from everything foreign. I gave each of the priests and Levites his own duties to carry out.

es.L: Y los purifiqué de todo lo extranjero, y establecí turnos para los sacerdotes y para los levitas, cada uno en su obra,
es.B: Así los purifiqué de todo lo extranjero, y fijé los turnos de los sacerdotes y de los levitas, cada uno en su tarea,
es.R: Así purifiqué a los sacerdotes y a los levitas de todo lo extranjero. A cada uno de ellos le asigné las tareas que debía cumplir.

fr.L: Et je les purifiai de tout ce qui était étranger, et j’établis des services pour les prêtres et pour les Lévites, chacun dans son ouvrage,
fr.B: Je les purifiai donc de tout ce qui était étranger, et je fixai les services des prêtres et des Lévites, chacun dans sa tâche,
fr.R: J’ai donc purifié les prêtres et les Lévites de tout ce qui était étranger. J’ai donné à chacun d’eux les tâches qu’il devait accomplir.

sw.L: Nikawatakasa na kila kitu cha kigeni, nikaweka zamu kwa ajili ya makuhani na kwa ajili ya Walawi, kila mtu katika kazi yake,
sw.B: Basi niliwatakasa na kila kitu cha kigeni, nikaweka zamu za makuhani na za Walawi, kila mmoja katika kazi yake,
sw.R: Basi niliwatakasa makuhani na Walawi na kila kitu cha kigeni. Nilimpa kila mmoja wao kazi zake za kufanya.

vi.L: Và tôi thanh tẩy họ khỏi mọi điều ngoại bang, và tôi lập các ban cho các thầy tế lễ và cho người Lê-vi, mỗi người trong công việc mình,
vi.B: Như vậy tôi thanh tẩy họ khỏi mọi điều ngoại bang, và sắp đặt các ban thứ cho các thầy tế lễ và người Lê-vi, ai nấy theo phận sự mình,
vi.R: Như vậy tôi làm cho các thầy tế lễ và người Lê-vi được tinh sạch khỏi mọi điều ngoại bang. Tôi giao cho mỗi người trong họ phận sự riêng phải làm.

ko.L: 그리고 나는 그들을 모든 이방의 것에서 정결하게 했고, 제사장들과 레위 사람들에게 직무를 정하여 각각 자기 일을 하게 했으며,
ko.B: 이렇게 나는 그들을 모든 이방의 것에서 깨끗하게 하고, 제사장들과 레위 사람들의 직무를 정하여 저마다 자기 일을 맡게 했으며,
ko.R: 이렇게 나는 제사장들과 레위 사람들을 모든 이방의 것에서 깨끗하게 했다. 그리고 그들 각 사람에게 해야 할 일을 정해 주었다.

pt.L: E os purifiquei de todo [elemento] estrangeiro, e estabeleci os turnos para os sacerdotes e para os levitas, cada um na sua obra,
pt.B: Assim eu os purifiquei de tudo o que era estrangeiro e estabeleci as funções dos sacerdotes e dos levitas, cada um na sua própria tarefa,
pt.R: Assim eu purifiquei os sacerdotes e os levitas de tudo o que era estrangeiro. Dei a cada um dos sacerdotes e levitas as suas próprias funções.

am.L: ከባዕድ ነገርም ሁሉ አነጻኋቸው፤ ለካህናቱና ለሌዋውያኑም እያንዳንዱ በሥራው ተራዎችን አቆምኩ፤
am.B: እንዲሁም ከባዕድ ነገር ሁሉ አነጻኋቸው፤ የካህናቱንና የሌዋውያኑን ተግባር፣ ለእያንዳንዱም ሥራውን ወሰንኩ፤
am.R: ስለዚህ ካህናቱንና ሌዋውያኑን ከባዕድ ነገር ሁሉ አነጻኋቸው። ለእያንዳንዱ ካህንና ሌዋዊ የሚሠራውን ሥራ ሰጠሁት።

hi.L: और मैंने उन्हें हर विदेशी बात से शुद्ध किया, और याजकों और लेवियों के लिए, हर एक के काम में, सेवा के भार ठहराए,
hi.B: इस प्रकार मैंने उन्हें हर विदेशी बात से शुद्ध किया, और याजकों और लेवियों के काम ठहराए, हर एक को उसका अपना काम,
hi.R: इस प्रकार मैंने याजकों और लेवियों को हर विदेशी बात से शुद्ध किया। मैंने हर याजक और हर लेवी को उसका अपना काम सौंपा।

ru.L: И я очистил их от всего чужеземного, и установил обязанности для священников и для левитов, каждому в его деле,
ru.B: Так я очистил их от всего чужеземного и установил обязанности священников и левитов, каждому в его деле,
ru.R: Так я очистил священников и левитов от всего чужеземного. Я дал каждому из священников и левитов его обязанности.

ja.L: そして、わたしは彼らをあらゆる外国のものから清め、祭司たちとレビ人たちのために、おのおのその仕事における務めを定めた。
ja.B: こうして、わたしは彼らをあらゆる外国のものから清め、祭司たちとレビ人たちの務めを、それぞれの仕事に応じて定めた。
ja.R: こうして、わたしは祭司とレビ人を、外国のあらゆるものから清めました。そして、祭司とレビ人の一人一人に、果たすべき務めを決めました。

decisions.choice: purified them from everything foreign
decisions.reason: Nehemiah removed foreign influence from the priests and Levites, the foreign marriages above all (verses 23-29), and so made them fit to serve.

decisions.choice: duties: the courses of service
decisions.reason: The word means watches or set duties: the divisions in which the priests and Levites took turns to serve (12:9, 24; 1 Chronicles 24-26).

decisions.choice: os turnos (L); as funções (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word names the courses in which priests and Levites took turns to serve (m2), "turno" as in 12:24 at Literal; Balanced and Readable say "funções", as the English says "duties".

source.text: וּלְקֻרְבַּ֧ן הָעֵצִ֛ים בְּעִתִּ֥ים מְזֻמָּנ֖וֹת וְלַבִּכּוּרִ֑יםזָכְרָה־לִּ֥י אֱלֹהַ֖י לְטוֹבָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: and for [the] offering of the wood at times appointed, and for the firstfruits. Remember for me, my God, for good.

en.L: and for the offering of the wood at appointed times, and for the firstfruits. Remember for me, my God, for good.
en.B: and I provided for the wood offering at the appointed times, and for the firstfruits. Remember me, my God, for good.
en.R: I also arranged for the wood for the altar to be brought at the right times, and for the first part of each harvest to be given. My God, remember me and be good to me.

es.L: y para la ofrenda de la leña en tiempos señalados, y para las primicias. Acuérdate de mí, Dios mío, para bien.
es.B: y dispuse lo necesario para la ofrenda de la leña en los tiempos señalados, y para las primicias. Acuérdate de mí, Dios mío, para bien.
es.R: También organicé que se trajera a tiempo la leña para el altar y que se entregara la primera parte de cada cosecha. Dios mío, acuérdate de mí y sé bueno conmigo.

fr.L: et pour l’offrande du bois à des temps fixés, et pour les prémices. Souviens-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} de moi, mon Dieu, pour [mon] bien.
fr.B: et je pourvus à l’offrande du bois aux temps fixés, ainsi qu’aux prémices. Souviens-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} de moi, mon Dieu, pour mon bien.
fr.R: J’ai aussi organisé l’apport du bois pour l’autel aux moments prévus, et le don de la première partie de chaque récolte. Mon Dieu, souviens-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} de moi et sois bon envers moi.

sw.L: na kwa ajili ya matoleo ya kuni kwa nyakati zilizoamriwa, na kwa ajili ya malimbuko. Unikumbuke, Ee Mungu wangu, kwa mema.
sw.B: na nikaweka utaratibu wa matoleo ya kuni kwa nyakati zilizoamriwa, na wa malimbuko. Ee Mungu wangu, unikumbuke kwa mema.
sw.R: Pia niliweka utaratibu wa kuleta kuni za madhabahu kwa nyakati zake, na wa kutoa sehemu ya kwanza ya kila mavuno. Ee Mungu wangu, unikumbuke na unitendee mema.

vi.L: và cho việc dâng củi vào những kỳ đã định, và cho hoa quả đầu mùa. Lạy Đức Chúa Trời của con, xin nhớ đến con để làm ơn cho con.
vi.B: và tôi sắp đặt việc dâng củi vào những thời điểm đã định, cùng việc dâng hoa quả đầu mùa. Lạy Đức Chúa Trời của con, xin nhớ đến con mà làm ơn cho con.
vi.R: Tôi cũng sắp xếp để củi dùng cho bàn thờ được đem đến đúng lúc, và để phần đầu tiên của mỗi vụ mùa được dâng lên. Lạy Đức Chúa Trời của con, xin nhớ đến con và ban ơn cho con.

ko.L: 정해진 때에 나무를 바치는 일과 첫 열매를 [위하여도 그렇게 했다]. 제 하나님, 저를 기억하시어 선을 베풀어 주십시오.
ko.B: 정해진 때에 땔나무를 바치는 일과 첫 열매를 바치는 일도 마련했다. 제 하나님, 저를 기억하시고 은혜를 베풀어 주십시오.
ko.R: 나는 또 제단에 쓸 나무를 제때 가져오게 하고, 해마다 처음 거둔 곡식을 바치게 했다. 제 하나님, 저를 기억해 주시고 저에게 잘해 주십시오.

pt.L: e para a oferta da lenha em tempos fixados, e para as primícias. Lembra-{{deity_pronoun:te|Te}}, ó meu Deus, a meu favor, para o bem.
pt.B: e providenciei a oferta de lenha nos tempos fixados, e também as primícias. Lembra-{{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} de mim, ó meu Deus, para o bem.
pt.R: Também organizei a entrega da lenha para o altar nos tempos certos e a entrega da primeira parte de cada colheita. Ó meu Deus, lembra-{{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} de mim e sê bondoso comigo.

am.L: ለእንጨቱም መባ በተወሰኑ ጊዜያት፣ ለበኩራቱም [አቆምኩ]። አምላኬ ሆይ፣ ለበጎ አስብልኝ።
am.B: በተወሰኑትም ጊዜያት ለሚቀርበው የእንጨት መባና ለበኩራቱ ዝግጅት አደረግኩ። አምላኬ ሆይ፣ ለበጎ አስበኝ።
am.R: ደግሞም የመሠዊያው እንጨት በተገቢው ጊዜ እንዲመጣ፣ የየመከሩም የመጀመሪያ ክፍል እንዲሰጥ አደረግኩ። አምላኬ ሆይ፣ አስበኝ፤ መልካምም አድርግልኝ።

hi.L: और ठहराए हुए समयों पर लकड़ी की भेंट के लिए, और पहली उपज के लिए। हे मेरे परमेश्वर, भलाई के लिए मेरे पक्ष में स्मरण कर।
hi.B: और मैंने ठहराए हुए समयों पर लकड़ी की भेंट का और पहली उपज का प्रबंध किया। हे मेरे परमेश्वर, भलाई के लिए मुझे स्मरण कर।
hi.R: मैंने यह भी प्रबंध किया कि वेदी के लिए लकड़ी ठीक समय पर लाई जाए, और हर फ़सल का पहला भाग दिया जाए। हे मेरे परमेश्वर, मुझे याद रख और मेरा भला कर।

ru.L: и для приношения дров в установленные времена, и для первых плодов. Вспомни мне, Боже мой, во благо.
ru.B: и позаботился о приношении дров в установленное время и о первых плодах. Вспомни меня, Боже мой, во благо.
ru.R: Я также устроил так, чтобы дрова для жертвенника приносили в нужное время и чтобы отдавали первую часть каждого урожая. Боже мой, вспомни меня и будь добр ко мне.

ja.L: また、定められた時のたきぎのささげ物と、初物について[定めた]。わたしの神よ、わたしのために覚えて、良くしてください。
ja.B: また、定められた時に行うたきぎのささげ物と、初物についても取り決めた。わたしの神よ、わたしを覚えて、わたしに恵みをお与えください。
ja.R: また、祭壇で燃やすたきぎを決められた時に運ぶことと、取り入れた作物の最初の分をささげることも、取り決めました。わたしの神よ、わたしを覚えていてください。そして、わたしに良くしてください。

decisions.choice: the wood offering
decisions.reason: The altar fire had to be kept burning always (Leviticus 6:5-6). The people had pledged to bring wood for it by lots, family by family, at set times (10:35), and to bring the firstfruits (10:36).

decisions.choice: Remember me, my God, for good: the book's last words
decisions.reason: The book ends with Nehemiah's prayer, as in 5:19 and 13:14, 22: he asks God to remember his work and treat him with favor. The word "good" here means God's kindness toward him.

decisions.choice: Remember for me, my God, for good (Literal); Remember me, my God, for good (Balanced); My God, remember me and be good to me (Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording of Nehemiah's prayer set for the whole book (5:19; 13:14, 22).

decisions.choice: I provided; I also arranged
decisions.reason: The Hebrew continues the list from verse 30 without a verb; Balanced and Readable supply one.

decisions.choice: verse 30 is left open ("…했으며,") and verse 31 supplies its own verb
alternatives: one Korean sentence ending only in verse 31 with no supplied verb
decisions.reason: The Hebrew list runs from verse 30 into verse 31 without a new verb; Korean needs a verb for each verse's items, which Literal brackets and Balanced states ("마련했다").

decisions.choice: Lembra-te, ó meu Deus, a meu favor, para o bem (L); Lembra-te de mim, ó meu Deus, para o bem (B); Ó meu Deus, lembra-te de mim e sê bondoso comigo (R)
decisions.reason: The book's last words (m2), Nehemiah's prayer in the words of 5:19 in Portuguese at each level, with "para o bem" for the Hebrew "for good"; Readable says what it asks, as the English Readable does. The wood offering and the firstfruits keep the words of 10:35-36 (m1).

decisions.choice: "ለበጎ አስብልኝ" (Literal), "ለበጎ አስበኝ" (Balanced); Readable "አስበኝ፤ መልካምም አድርግልኝ", as the English Readable
decisions.reason: The book's last words keep the refrain of verses 14 and 22; the wood offering and the firstfruits as in 10:35-36.

decisions.choice: "わたしのために覚えて、良くしてください" (L), "わたしを覚えて、わたしに恵みをお与えください" (B), "わたしを覚えていてください。そして、わたしに良くしてください" (R)
decisions.reason: The refrain of 5:19 (NEH-1), so the book ends as Nehemiah's first prayer did; たきぎのささげ物 as 10:35.
